```CT
    function toggleCompactView(sender, forceEnable)
        local isCompactMode = not (compactViewMenuItem.Caption == 'Compact View Mode')
        if forceEnable ~= nil then
            isCompactMode = not forceEnable
        end

        synchronize(function()
            compactViewMenuItem.Caption = isCompactMode and 'Compact View Mode' or 'Full View Mode'
            getMainForm().Splitter1.Visible = isCompactMode
            getMainForm().Panel4.Visible    = isCompactMode
            getMainForm().Panel5.Visible    = isCompactMode
        end)
```

```CT
if not toggleCompactView then
    function toggleCompactView(sender, forceEnable)
        local isCompactMode = not (compactViewMenuItem.Caption == 'Compact View Mode')
        if forceEnable ~= nil then
            isCompactMode = not forceEnable
        end

    synchronize(function()
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = isCompactMode and 'Compact View Mode' or 'Full View Mode'
        getMainForm().Splitter1.Visible = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel4.Visible    = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel5.Visible    = isCompactMode
    end)
end
end

if not createCompactViewMenu then
    function createCompactViewMenu()
        if isCompactMenuCreated then return end

    synchronize(function()
        local mainMenu = getMainForm().Menu.Items
        compactViewMenuItem = createMenuItem(mainMenu)
        mainMenu.add(compactViewMenuItem)
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = 'Compact View Mode'
        compactViewMenuItem.OnClick = toggleCompactView
    end)

    isCompactMenuCreated = true
end
end

createCompactViewMenu()
toggleCompactView(nil, true)

registerCustomTypeAutoAssembler([[
alloc(TypeName,256)
alloc(ByteSize,8)
alloc(ConvertRoutine,1024)
alloc(ConvertBackRoutine,1024)
alloc(UsesFloat,1)

TypeName:
db 'A14DayInt',0

ByteSize:
dd 4

UsesFloat:
db 0

ConvertRoutine:
//at this point ecx contains the address where the bytes are stored

xor rax,rax
push rdx

mov eax, dword ptr [rcx]
sub eax, #89

pop rdx
ret

ConvertBackRoutine:
//at this point edx contains the address to write the value to
//and ecx contains the value

push rax
xor rax, rax
push rdx
mov eax, ecx
add eax, #89
mov dword ptr [rdx], eax
pop rdx
pop rax
ret

]])

_ayesha_customInt = true

-- 定義計時器
timer = createTimer(nil, false)
timer.Interval = 2000

-- Memory Record ID 為 178 的對象
local memoryRecord = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID(178)

-- 日期memory地址
local dateAddress = getAddress("Atelier_Ayesha.exe+1B5CA00")

-- 定義更新日期的函數
function updateDate()
    -- 讀取32位整數字節的前日期值
    local currentDateValue = readInteger(dateAddress)

    if currentDateValue then
        local year = math.floor((currentDateValue-89) / 360) + 1
        local dayOfYear = currentDateValue % 360
        local month = math.floor(dayOfYear / 30) + 1
        local day = (dayOfYear % 30) + 1

        -- 設置 MemoryRecord 對象的描述
        memoryRecord.Description = string.format("Year:%d Month:%02d Day:%02d", year, month, day)
    end
end

-- 啟動計時器並綁定更新日期函數
timer.OnTimer = updateDate
timer.Enabled = true
closeLuaEngine()
[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end
-- 停用計時器
if timer then
    timer.destroy()
    timer = nil
end
local memoryRecord = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID(178)
memoryRecord.Description = "Year:? Month:?? Day:??"
closeLuaEngine()

label(code)
label(return)
label(vf_mempt_multi)

newmem:
  test ecx, ecx
  jz code
  vmovss xmm14, [vf_mempt_multi]
  vcvtsi2ss xmm15, xmm15, ecx
  vmulss xmm15, xmm14, xmm15
  vcvtss2si ecx, xmm15

code:
  add edx,ecx
  add ecx,[Atelier_Ayesha.exe+1B563D4]
  jmp return
align 10 cc
  vf_mempt_multi:
  dd (float)1.5

INJECT_MEMPT_MULTI:
  jmp newmem
  nop 3
return:

      currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize

MaxBasketCount = 120
BaseBasketOffset=0x1B68010
BaseContainerOffset=0x1B68F10
EquipsOffset=0x108A8B0
ItemRecordSize = 32 --0x20

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end
end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {438,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence


function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```CT
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if not toggleCompactView then
    function toggleCompactView(sender, forceEnable)
        local isCompactMode = not (compactViewMenuItem.Caption == 'Compact View Mode')
        if forceEnable ~= nil then
            isCompactMode = not forceEnable
        end

    synchronize(function()
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = isCompactMode and 'Compact View Mode' or 'Full View Mode'
        getMainForm().Splitter1.Visible = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel4.Visible    = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel5.Visible    = isCompactMode
    end)
end
end

if not createCompactViewMenu then
    function createCompactViewMenu()
        if isCompactMenuCreated then return end

    synchronize(function()
        local mainMenu = getMainForm().Menu.Items
        compactViewMenuItem = createMenuItem(mainMenu)
        mainMenu.add(compactViewMenuItem)
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = 'Compact View Mode'
        compactViewMenuItem.OnClick = toggleCompactView
    end)

    isCompactMenuCreated = true
end
end

createCompactViewMenu()
toggleCompactView(nil, true)

[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if toggleCompactView then
    toggleCompactView(nil, false)
end

</AssemblerScript>

{$asm}

label(TARGET_QUALITY)
label(TARGET_QUANTITY)
label(TARGET_QUANTITY_MIN)

newmem:
  TARGET_QUALITY:
  dd (float)120
  TARGET_QUANTITY:
  db 32
  TARGET_QUANTITY_MIN:
  db 2

registersymbol(TARGET_QUALITY)
registersymbol(TARGET_QUANTITY)
registersymbol(TARGET_QUANTITY_MIN)
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end

_G.process2 = process
_G.processID = getOpenedProcessID()

-- Attempt to get process address
local baseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Escha_and_Logy.exe')

-- If Atelier_Escha_and_Logy.exe is not found, try to get Atelier_Escha_and_Logy_EN.exe
if baseAddress == nil then
  baseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Escha_and_Logy_EN.exe')
end

-- Check if the process is found
if baseAddress == nil then
  print("Please select process Atelier_Ayesha.exe first")
  print("Please close Cheat Engine and load this table again")
  print("最初に「Atelier_Escha_and_Logy.exe」プロセスを選択してください。")
  print("Cheat Engineを閉じて、再びこのテーブルをロードしてください。")
else
  g_containerBaseAddress = baseAddress + BaseContainerOffset
  g_SynthesisBaseAddress = baseAddress + BaseSynthesisOffset
  closeLuaEngine()
end

{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end

    if aob_addr_str then
      local name_addr_str = getAddressSafe(aob_addr_str) + v.pos
      local name_addr_val = readInteger(name_addr_str)
      local aob_addr_val = tonumber(aob_addr_str, 16)

      -- For rank_base, create rank_base_y1m1
      if v.symbol == "rank_base" then

        registerSymbol("rank_base_y1m1", rank_base_y1m1_addr)
      end

      -- Debug output
      --print(string.format("%s address: %08X", v.name, final_addr_val))

      print(string.format("AOB scan failed: %s", v.name))
    end
  end

local memoryRecord = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID(9)

--local dateAddress = getAddress("Atelier_Escha_and_Logy.exe+1451ECC")
local dateAddress = getAddress("day_base")

function updateDate()
    local currentDateValue = readInteger(dateAddress)

    if currentDateValue then
        local year = math.floor((currentDateValue - 89) / 360) + 1
        local dayOfYear = currentDateValue % 360
        local month = math.floor(dayOfYear / 30) + 1
        local day = (dayOfYear % 30) + 1

        local deadlineDay = 120 - ((currentDateValue - 89) % 120)

        memoryRecord.Description = string.format("Year:%d Month:%02d Day:%02d (%03d)", year, month, day, deadlineDay)
    end
end

timerA15.OnTimer = updateDate
timerA15.Enabled = true
getLuaEngine().Close()

local function updateQuality(baseOffset, maxCount, recordSize, quality)
  local baseAddress = getAddressSafe(process) + baseOffset
  local currentAddress = baseAddress

  for i = 1, maxCount do
    local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddress)
    if currentID &gt;= 0xFFFF then break end

    writeFloat(currentAddress + 0x4, quality)
    if currentID % 25 == 0 then
      print(string.format("NO: %d, ID: %d, (addr: %08X) set quality to %.2f", i, currentID, currentAddress, quality))
    end
    currentAddress = currentAddress + recordSize
  end
end

local quality = readFloat("TARGET_QUALITY")
updateQuality(BaseContainerOffset, MaxContainerCount, ItemRecordSize, quality)
updateQuality(BaseSynthesisOffset, MaxSynthesisCount, ItemRecordSize, quality)

print("Done.")
getLuaEngine().Close()

  print("Please select item first")
  return

local srcQualityAddress = itemBaseAddr

getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()

if getAddressSafe(process) == nil then
  print("Game process not found?")
else
  -- Author : bbfox @ https://open cheat tables. com/
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress
  local SynthesisBaseAddress = g_SynthesisBaseAddress
  print("Container base address: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))
  print("Synthesis base address: " .. string.format("%08X", SynthesisBaseAddress))

  local itemBaseAddress = 0
  local iMaxCount = 0

  if srcQualityAddress &lt; containerBaseAddress then
    if srcQualityAddress &gt;= SynthesisBaseAddress then
      itemBaseAddress = SynthesisBaseAddress
      iMaxCount = MaxSynthesisCount
    else
      itemBaseAddress = containerBaseAddress
      iMaxCount = 0
      print("****Item address out of range; Abort.")
    end
  else
    itemBaseAddress = containerBaseAddress
    --iMaxCount = MaxContainerCount
    iMaxCount = 0
    print("****Materials cannot be duplicated.")
  end

  local isFound = false
  local previousItemID = 1
  local currentItemID = 0
  local currentQuality = readFloat(srcQualityAddress + 0x04)
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destination, quality should not be the same if not in 120
  local dupCount = 3
  local currentQualityAddress = itemBaseAddress

  print("Src quality: " .. currentQuality)
  print("Src serial: " .. readSmallInteger(srcQualityAddress))

  for i = 1, iMaxCount - 4, 1 do
    if not isFound then
      currentItemID = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

      if currentItemID == 0xFFFF and i &gt; 1 then
        print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " .. currentQuality)
        isFound = true

        for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1 do
          print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", previousItemID + 1)

          -- Offset:
          -- 0-1: serial
          -- 2-3: item ID
          -- 4-7: eff
          -- 8-31: others
          -- Duplicate item data to new slots

          ----
          ----previousItemID = previousItemID + 1
          ----writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, previousItemID) -- Serial

          -- Copy rest of the data (offset 4~31)
          for offset = 0, ItemRecordSize - 1 do
            local byteValue = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + offset, 1, false)
            writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + offset, byteValue)
          end

          -- Update address pointers for the next duplicate
          currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
        end
      end

      previousItemID = currentItemID
      currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
    else
      break
    end
  end

  print("Done")
  if iMaxCount &gt; 0 then
    getLuaEngine().Close()
  end
end

--determine event trigger sequence


function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end

function getProcessNameFromPID(pid)
  local sl = createStringList()
  getProcessList(sl)
  local hexPid = string.format("%X", pid):upper()

  for i = 0, sl.Count - 1 do
    local entry = sl[i]
    local hexid, name = entry:match("^(%x+)%-(.+)$")
    if hexid and name then
      if tonumber(hexid, 16) == pid then
        return name
      end
    end
  end
  return "(unknown)"
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('getProcessNameFromPID')

function printProcessInfo()
  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
  local name = getProcessNameFromPID(pid)
  print(string.format("🧠 Attached to process: %s (PID: %d / 0x%X)", name, pid, pid))
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('printProcessInfo')

function dumpProcessListAndFindPID()
  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
  print(string.format("🎯 Current PID: %d / 0x%X", pid, pid))

  local sl = createStringList()
  getProcessList(sl)

  print("📋 Dumping process list:")
  for i = 0, sl.Count - 1 do
    local entry = sl[i]
    print(string.format("[%d] %s", i, entry))

    -- 嘗試解析並比對 PID
    local name, hexid = entry:match("(.+)%-(%x+)$")
    if name and hexid then
      local parsed = tonumber(hexid, 16)
      if parsed == pid then
        print("✅ Match found in process list:")
        print(string.format("Name: %s | PID: %s (0x%s)", name, parsed, hexid))
      end
    end
  end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('dumpProcessListAndFindPID')
```

```CT
--Main script start

clearLuaLog()

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Firis_DX.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Please select process Atelier_Firis_DX.exe first")
else
  local equipItemsBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Firis_DX.exe')+BaseEquipItemsOffset

  minQuality = 0  --min. Quality check value

  currentQualityAddress = equipItemsBaseAddress

  isOkay = false
  local checkSum=0
  for i = 1, 10, 1
  do
    checkSum = checkSum+readBytes(equipItemsBaseAddress - i, 1, false)
  end
  isOkay = (checkSum == 0)

  for i = 1, MaxEquipItemsCount, 1
  do
    --Item quality (1-999)
    currentCountValue = readBytes(currentQualityAddress + 0x25, 1, false)
    maxCountValue = readBytes(currentQualityAddress + 0x26, 1, false)

    currentID = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress) -- Item ID

    if ( currentID &lt; 65535 )
    then
      if (currentCountValue &lt; maxCountValue)
      then
        print("#" .. i .. ", set count from " .. currentCountValue .. " to " .. maxCountValue)
        writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + 0x25, maxCountValue)
      end
    else
      break
    end

    currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
  end

  print("Done")
  if (not isOkay)
  then
    Print("******CheckSum error, data may be corrputed!! ")
  end
end

clearLuaLog()
if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Firis_DX.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Please select process Atelier_Firis_DX.exe first")
else
  local basketBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Firis_DX.exe')+BaseBasketOffset

  isFound = false
  isOkay = false
  prevID0 = 1
  prevID1 = 0
  currentQualityAddress = basketBaseAddress --base item address for basket
  prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  local checkSum=0
  for i = 1, 96, 1
  do
    checkSum = checkSum+readBytes(basketBaseAddress - i, 1, false)
  end
  isOkay = (checkSum ==0)

  if (isOkay)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxBasketCount-3, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress +2) --get Item Type ID instead of Item ID
        currentID1 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress) --Get ID, different than Sophie, ID is assigned in basket

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) )
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, 3, 1
          do
            prevID1 = prevID1 + 1
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", Item type ID: ", prevID0)
            writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID1)
            for i2 = 2, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              thebyte = readBytes(prevQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
              writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        prevID1 = currentID1

        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
    print("Done.")

  else
    Print("******Data checkSum error, script stopped!")
  end
  print("Done")
end

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Firis_DX.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Please select process Atelier_Firis_DX.exe first")
else

  local containerBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Firis_DX.exe')+BaseContainerOffset

  isFound = false
  prevID0 = 1

  currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  isOkay = false
  local checkSum=0
  for i = 3, 52, 1
  do
    checkSum = checkSum+readBytes(containerBaseAddress - i, 1, false)
  end
  isOkay = (checkSum == 8670)

  for i = 1, MaxContainerCount-5, 1
  do
    if (isFound == false)
    then
      currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

      if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
      then
        print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) )
        isFound = true
        for i1 = 1, 5, 1
        do
          print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
          for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
          do
            if (i2 == 0)
            then
              prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
              writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
            end
            if (i2 &gt; 1)
            then
              thebyte = readBytes(prevQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
              writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
            end
          end
          prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
          currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
        end
      end

      prevID0 = currentID0
      prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
      currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
    else
      break
    end
  end

  print("Done")
  if (not isOkay)
  then
    Print("******")
  end
end
```

```CT
itemBaseAddr=readPointer("itemBaseAddr")
print("Base item addr: " .. string.format("%08X", itemBaseAddr))

srcQualityAddress = itemBaseAddr
--0x10F1550

--for ib = 0, 37, 1
--do

--  print(string.format("%02X", barray[ib]))

clearLuaLog()

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Please select process Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe first")
else
  --BaseContainerOffset=0x10C2040
  --ItemRecordSize=38
  --MaxContainerCount=4000
  local containerBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseContainerOffset

  isFound = false
  IsBypass = false
  prevID0 = 1
  currentID0 = 0
  currentQlty = 0
  dupCount = 2

  currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local testBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseActivatorOffset
  local WeaponBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseWeaponOffset
  local ArmorBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseArmorOffset
  local GearBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseGearOffset
  local EndAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseoffsetEnd



  if (srcQualityAddress &gt;= testBaseAddress and srcQualityAddress &lt; WeaponBaseAddress)
  then
    --活性化
    currentQualityAddress = testBaseAddress --base item address for Activator / アニマ
    MaxCount = MaxActivatorCount
    dupCount = 1
  end

  if (srcQualityAddress &gt;= WeaponBaseAddress and srcQualityAddress &lt; ArmorBaseAddress)
  then
    --Weapon
    currentQualityAddress = WeaponBaseAddress
    MaxCount = MaxEquipCount
    dupCount = 1
  end

  if (srcQualityAddress &gt;= ArmorBaseAddress and srcQualityAddress &lt; GearBaseAddress)
  then
    --Armor
    currentQualityAddress = ArmorBaseAddress
    MaxCount = MaxEquipCount
    dupCount = 1
  end

  if (srcQualityAddress &gt;= GearBaseAddress and srcQualityAddress &lt; EndAddress)
  then
    --Assoc
    currentQualityAddress = GearBaseAddress
    MaxCount = MaxEquipCount
    dupCount = 1
  end

  local forbBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('Atelier_Lydie_and_Suelle_DX.exe')+BaseImportantOffset
  --do not duplicate important items
  if (srcQualityAddress &lt; testBaseAddress and srcQualityAddress &gt;= testBaseAddress)
  then
    IsBypass = true
    dupCount = 0
  end


  prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) )
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if (i2 &gt; 1)
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end


              if (i2 == (ItemRecordSize-1))
              then
                currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 4)
                --adjust quality value to avoid highlight editor address bugs
                if (currentQlty &lt; 999)
                then
                  if (i1 % 2 == 0)
                  then
                    writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 4, currentQlty)
                  else
                    currentQlty = currentQlty + 1
                    writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 4, currentQlty)
                  end
                end
              end
            end

            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

      shapeID3 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x1A)

              writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x1C, shapeID3)

          end
        end
      else
        break
```

```CT
--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {41, 158, 208,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence


function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment 1 byte
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```CT
if not toggleCompactView then
    function toggleCompactView(sender, forceEnable)
        local isCompactMode = not (compactViewMenuItem.Caption == 'Compact View Mode')
        if forceEnable ~= nil then
            isCompactMode = not forceEnable
        end

    synchronize(function()
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = isCompactMode and 'Compact View Mode' or 'Full View Mode'
        getMainForm().Splitter1.Visible = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel4.Visible    = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel5.Visible    = isCompactMode
    end)
end
end

if not createCompactViewMenu then
    function createCompactViewMenu()
        if isCompactMenuCreated then return end

    synchronize(function()
        local mainMenu = getMainForm().Menu.Items
        compactViewMenuItem = createMenuItem(mainMenu)
        mainMenu.add(compactViewMenuItem)
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = 'Compact View Mode'
        compactViewMenuItem.OnClick = toggleCompactView
    end)

    isCompactMenuCreated = true
end
end

createCompactViewMenu()
toggleCompactView(nil, true)

[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if toggleCompactView then
    toggleCompactView(nil, false)
end

ConvertRoutine:
//at this point ecx contains the address where the bytes are stored

xor rax,rax
push rdx

mov eax, dword ptr [rcx]
sub eax, #89

pop rdx
ret

ConvertBackRoutine:
//at this point edx contains the address to write the value to
//and ecx contains the value

push rax
xor rax, rax
push rdx
mov eax, ecx
add eax, #89
mov dword ptr [rdx], eax
pop rdx
pop rax
ret

]])

_meruru_customInt = true
end

if getOpenedProcessID() ~= _G.processID then
  openProcess(_G.processID)
end

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end
end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {438,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence


function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment 1 byte
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```CT
-- 📏 SafeMonoDestroy: Clean up all Mono-related state
if _G.SafeMonoDestroy == nil then
  _G.SafeMonoDestroy = function()
    print("🪚 SafeMonoDestroy: Begin cleanup...")

    -- 1. Stop symbol enumeration thread if running
    if monoSymbolEnum then
      print("🚬 Terminating monoSymbolEnum thread...")
      pcall(function()
        monoSymbolEnum.terminate()
        if not monoSymbolEnum.waitfor(3000) then
          print("⚠ Timeout: monoSymbolEnum didn't terminate in time")
        end
        monoSymbolEnum.destroy()
        monoSymbolEnum = nil
      end)
    end

    -- 2. Stop progressbar timer
    if monoSymbolList and monoSymbolList.progressbar then
      monoSymbolList.progressbar.OnTimer = nil
    end

    -- 3. Unlock pipe (try unlock even if uncertain)
    print("🔓 Attempting to unlock pipe...")
    pcall(function()
      if monopipe and monopipe.unlock then
        monopipe.unlock()
      end
    end)

    -- 4. Delay before destroy to let MonoCollector finish its work
    print("⌛ Waiting before destroy (sleep 250ms)...")
    sleep(250)  -- let it flush pipe state

    -- 5. Destroy main pipe
    local t0 = os.clock()
    print(string.format("🚨 Destroying monopipe，This may take several minutes (or longer)👺👺👺... [Start: %.3fs]", t0))

    pcall(function()
      if monopipe then
        monopipe.destroy()
        monopipe = nil
      end
    end)

    local t1 = os.clock()
    print(string.format("👻 monopipe.destroy() completed [End: %.3fs | Duration: %.3fs]", t1, t1 - t0))


    -- 6. Destroy symbol list
    if monoSymbolList then
      monoSymbolList.destroy()
      monoSymbolList = nil
    end

    -- 7. Destroy event pipe if exists
    if monoeventpipe then
      monoeventpipe.destroy()
      monoeventpipe = nil
    end

    print("👻 SafeMonoDestroy: Cleanup complete.")
  end
end

-- 列出指定 class 中、同名方法的所有 overload，回傳詳盡資訊（不註冊符號）
if _G.mono_listMethodsByName == nil then
  _G.mono_listMethodsByName = function(namespace, classname, methodname)
    local cls = mono_findClass(namespace, classname)
    if not cls then
      print(string.format("💔 Class not found: %s.%s", namespace, classname))
      return {}
    end

    local mtds = mono_class_enumMethods(cls)
    if not mtds then
      print(string.format("💔 No methods in: %s.%s", namespace, classname))
      return {}
    end

    local out = {}
    local cnt = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(mtds) do
      if v.name == methodname then
        local entry = { name = v.name, method = v.method }

        -- 參數/回傳型別（用 CE 提供的 parameters API，比較穩）
        local okP, p = pcall(mono_method_get_parameters, v.method)
        if okP and p and p.parameters then
          entry.params = p.parameters         -- array of {typename=..., name=...}
          entry.paramnames = {}
          for i, pi in ipairs(p.parameters) do
            entry.paramnames[i] = pi.name
          end
          entry.returntype = p.returntype and p.returntype.name or nil
        else
          -- 後備：某些版本 mono_method_getSignature 可能回傳字串或多返回值
          local okS, a, b, c = pcall(mono_method_getSignature, v.method)
          if okS then
            -- 嘗試相容 ijm_mtd_by_sig 的 (params, paramnames, returntype)
            entry.params      = a
            entry.paramnames  = b
            entry.returntype  = c
            entry.signature   = type(a) == "string" and a or nil
          end
        end

        -- 編譯 JIT 取得地址
        local addr = mono_compile_method(v.method)
        entry.address = addr

        cnt = cnt + 1
        out[cnt] = entry
      end
    end

    print(string.format("🔎 Found %d overload(s) for %s.%s.%s", cnt, namespace, classname, methodname))
    return out
  end
end

-- 產生欄位 offset 對照表（若 CE 版本支援欄位列舉/offset 取得）
if _G.mono_offsetsTable == nil then
  _G.mono_offsetsTable = function(cacheTable, classname, namespace, opts)
    -- 行為與 ijm_offset_table 類似：若已有表且非空就直接回傳
    if cacheTable and type(cacheTable) == "table" then
      local hasAny = next(cacheTable) ~= nil
      if hasAny then return cacheTable end
    end

    local t = {}
    local cls = mono_findClass(namespace or "", classname)
    if not cls then
      print(string.format("💔 Class not found: %s.%s", namespace or "", classname))
      return t
    end

    -- 嘗試列舉欄位
    local fields = nil
    if mono_class_enumFields then
      local okF, res = pcall(mono_class_enumFields, cls)
      if okF then fields = res end
    end

    if not fields or #fields == 0 then
      print("⚠ 無法列舉欄位（當前 CE/Mono 外掛可能不支援 mono_class_enumFields）。")
      return t
    end

    for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
      local fname = f.name or ("&lt;noname_"..tostring(_).."&gt;")
      local off = nil
      if mono_field_get_offset then
        local okO, o = pcall(mono_field_get_offset, f.field)
        if okO then off = o end
      end
      t[fname] = off
    end

    -- 若需要標註是 Mono 單例/IL2CPP Enum 等，可透過 opts 設定，這裡僅示意保留
    if opts and opts.meta then t.__meta = opts.meta end

    return t
  end
end

-- 📏 Register symbol by parameter type array (exact match)
if _G.mono_registerSymbolEx == nil then
  _G.mono_registerSymbolEx = function(symbolname, namespace, classname, methodname, paramTypes)
    local cls = mono_findClass(namespace, classname)
    if not cls then
      print(string.format("💔 Error: Class not found - %s.%s", namespace, classname))
      return
    end

    local methods = mono_class_enumMethods(cls)
    for _, m in ipairs(methods) do
      if m.name == methodname then
        local p = mono_method_get_parameters(m.method)
        local matched = true

        if #p.parameters ~= #paramTypes then
          matched = false
        else
          for i = 1, #paramTypes do
            if not string.find(p.parameters[i].typename, paramTypes[i], 1, true) then
              matched = false
              break
            end
          end
        end

        if matched then
          local addr = mono_compile_method(m.method)
          if addr == 0 then
            print("💔 Error: Method found but failed to compile.")
            return
          end
          registerSymbol(symbolname, addr)
          print(string.format("🪧 Symbol registered: %s = %X", symbolname, addr))
          return
        end
      end
    end

    print(string.format("💔 Error: No matching method found - %s.%s.%s", namespace, classname, methodname))
  end
end

-- 📏 Register symbol by partial signature match (overload-safe, with excludes and match info)
if _G.mono_registerSymbolBySignatureMatch == nil then
  _G.mono_registerSymbolBySignatureMatch = function(symbolname, namespace, classname, methodname, sigContains, sigExcludes)
    local cls = mono_findClass(namespace, classname)
    if not cls then
      print(string.format("💔 Error: Class not found - %s.%s", namespace, classname))
      return
    end

    local methods = mono_class_enumMethods(cls)
    if not methods then
      print(string.format("💔 Error: No methods found in %s.%s", namespace, classname))
      return
    end

    for _, m in ipairs(methods) do
      if m.name == methodname then
        local sig = mono_method_getSignature(m.method)
        local matched = true

        -- Check required substrings
        for _, kw in ipairs(sigContains) do
          if not string.find(sig, kw, 1, true) then
            matched = false
            break
          end
        end

        -- Check excluded substrings (if given)
        if matched and sigExcludes then
          for _, ex in ipairs(sigExcludes) do
            if string.find(sig, ex, 1, true) then
              matched = false
              break
            end
          end
        end

        if matched then
          local addr = mono_compile_method(m.method)
          if addr == 0 then
            print("💔 Error: Signature matched but failed to compile method.")
            return
          end
          registerSymbol(symbolname, addr)
          print(string.format("🪧 Symbol registered: %s = %X", symbolname, addr))
          print(string.format("🔎 Matched Signature: %s", sig))
          return
        end
      end
    end

    print(string.format("💔 Error: No matching signature found - %s.%s.%s", namespace, classname, methodname))
  end
end


-- 📏 Register symbol by simple method name (first match)
if _G.mono_registerSymbol == nil then
  _G.mono_registerSymbol = function(symbolname, namespace, classname, methodname)
    local m = mono_findMethod(namespace, classname, methodname)
    if m == nil or m == 0 then
      print(string.format("💔 Error: Method not found - %s.%s.%s", namespace, classname, methodname))
      return
    end

    local addr = mono_compile_method(m)
    if addr == 0 then
      print(string.format("💔 Error: Could not compile method - %s.%s.%s", namespace, classname, methodname))
      return
    end

    registerSymbol(symbolname, addr)
    print(string.format("🪧 Symbol registered: %s = %X", symbolname, addr))
  end
end

-- ⚡ Example usage - Register Mono methods to CE symbol table
-- These functions compile (JIT) a Mono method and register it as a CE symbol

-- 🔹 1. mono_registerSymbol(symbolname, namespace, classname, methodname)
-- Description: Registers the first matched method with given name.
-- ⚠ Use this only when there's no overload (or you're fine with the first one).
-- Params:
--   symbolname: The name you want to register (used in CE as a label)
--   namespace:  Mono namespace of the class (can be "" if none)
--   classname:  Class name that contains the method
--   methodname: Method name to find (first match will be used)
-- Example:

--_G.mono_registerSymbol("MyAttack", "Game.Logic", "BattleManager", "Attack")
--_G.mono_registerSymbol("UseAbility_Any", "Elin", "Chara", "UseAbility")


-- 🔹 2. mono_registerSymbolEx(symbolname, namespace, classname, methodname, paramTypes)
-- Description: Registers a method that exactly matches the provided parameter types.
-- Use this when there are multiple overloads of a method.
-- Params:
--   symbolname: The name to register
--   namespace:  Mono namespace
--   classname:  Class name
--   methodname: Method name (exact match)
--   paramTypes: Array of expected parameter type strings (must match count &amp; order)
--               These are matched using `string.find`, so partial match is allowed.
-- Example:
--   UseAbility(string idAct, Card tc, Point pos, bool pt)

--[[
_G.mono_registerSymbolEx("UseAbility_Exact", "Elin", "Chara", "UseAbility", {
  "System.String", "Card", "Point", "System.Boolean"
})
--]]


-- 🔹 3. mono_registerSymbolBySignatureMatch(symbolname, namespace, classname, methodname, sigContains, sigExcludes)
-- Description: Registers the method whose signature contains all given substrings.
-- Flexible, and suitable when exact type names vary or signature format is uncertain.
-- Params:
--   symbolname: The symbol name to register
--   namespace:  Mono namespace
--   classname:  Class name
--   methodname: Method name (will scan all overloads)
--   sigContains: Array of strings that should all appear in the method signature
--                e.g., { "Act", "Card", "Point", "bool" }
--   sigExcludes: Signatures to exclude
-- Example:
--   Will match method like: UseAbility(Act a, Card tc, Point pos, bool pt)

--[[
_G.mono_registerSymbolBySignatureMatch("UseAbility_Act", "Elin", "Chara", "UseAbility", {
  "Act", "Card", "Point", "bool"
})

_G.mono_registerSymbolBySignatureMatch("GetItemCount_Item", "Assembly-CSharp", "ItemStorage", "GetItemCount",
  {"Item"},      -- sigContains
  {"List"}       -- sigExcludes
)

Signatures above:
System.Collections.Generic.List&lt;Item&gt; 
Item 

** Both have "Item" but first one have "List"
--]]

  <LuaScript>--[[
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
]]--
-- **デバッグモードの設定 (デフォルト: 無効)**
local debugMode = false

-- AOBScanModule関数
if not AOBScanModule then
    function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
        local baseAddr = nil
        local maxAddr = 0
        local modList

        synchronize(function()
            modList = enumModules()
        end)

        for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
            if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
                baseAddr = mod.Address
                maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
                break
            end
        end

        if not baseAddr then
            if debugMode then print("❗ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!") end
            return nil
        end

        if debugMode then
            print(string.format("✔️ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
            print(string.format("🔬 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))
        end

        local ms = createMemScan()

        synchronize(function()
            ms.firstScan(
                soExactValue,
                vtByteArray,
                nil,
                signature,
                nil,
                baseAddr,
                maxAddr,
                scanOptions or "+X+R",
                fsmNotAligned,
                "1",
                true,
                true,
                false,
                false
            )
        end)

        ms.waitTillDone()

        local results = createFoundList(ms)
        results.initialize()

        local addr
        synchronize(function()
            if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
                addr = results[0]
            end
        end)

        if addr then
            if debugMode then print("🔦 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr) end
        else
            if debugMode then print("💔 AOB not found in " .. moduleName) end
        end

        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    end
end

registerLuaFunctionHighlight('AOBScanModule')

--[[
test AOBScanModule()
local aob_addr_str = AOBScanModule("???.exe", "48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 33 ED 48 8B 88", "+X+R")
if aob_addr_str then
    print("🔦 Final AOB Address: 0x" .. aob_addr_str)
else
    print("💔 AOB not found in ???.exe")
end
]]--

-- Lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment/script body
if not onMemRecPostExecute then
    function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded)
        if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
            synchronize(function()
                memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- Memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {999999, 9999999}

-- Determine event trigger sequence
if not contains then
    function contains(table, val)
       for i = 1, #table do
          if table[i] == val then
             return true
          end
       end
       return false
    end
end

if not onMemRecPreExecute then
    function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
        if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
            synchronize(function()
                if not memoryrecord.OnActivate then
                    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- Utility Functions
-- Clear lua engine log
if not clearLuaLog then
    function clearLuaLog()
        synchronize(function()
          getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()
        end)
    end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('clearLuaLog')

-- Close lua engine log
if not closeLuaEngine then
    function closeLuaEngine()
        synchronize(function()
          getLuaEngine().Close()
        end)
    end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('closeLuaEngine')

-- Clear lua engine log &amp; close lua engine
if not closeLuaEngine2 then
    function closeLuaEngine2()
        synchronize(function()
          getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()
          getLuaEngine().Close()
        end)
    end
end

if not getProcessNameFromPID then
	function getProcessNameFromPID(pid)
	  local sl = createStringList()
	  getProcessList(sl)
	  local hexPid = string.format("%X", pid):upper()

	  for i = 0, sl.Count - 1 do
		local entry = sl[i]
		local hexid, name = entry:match("^(%x+)%-(.+)$")
		if hexid and name then
		  if tonumber(hexid, 16) == pid then
			return name
		  end
		end
	  end
	  return "(unknown)"
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('getProcessNameFromPID')

if not printProcessInfo then
	function printProcessInfo()
	  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
	  local name = getProcessNameFromPID(pid)
	  print(string.format("📎 Attached to process: %s (PID: %d / 0x%X)", name, pid, pid))
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('printProcessInfo')

if not dumpProcessListAndFindPID then
	function dumpProcessListAndFindPID()
	  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
	  print(string.format("💭 Current PID: %d / 0x%X", pid, pid))

	  local sl = createStringList()
	  getProcessList(sl)

	  print("🧾 Dumping process list:")
	  for i = 0, sl.Count - 1 do
		local entry = sl[i]
		print(string.format("[%d] %s", i, entry))

		-- 嘗試解析並比對 PID
		local name, hexid = entry:match("(.+)%-(%x+)$")
		if name and hexid then
		  local parsed = tonumber(hexid, 16)
		  if parsed == pid then
			print("🔦 Match found in process list:")
			print(string.format("Name: %s | PID: %s (0x%s)", name, parsed, hexid))
		  end
		end
	  end
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('dumpProcessListAndFindPID')

if not toHex32 then
	function toHex32(num)
		local hexstr = "0123456789ABCDEF"
		local result = ""
		if num &lt; 0 then
			num = (num + (1 &lt;&lt; 32)) % (1 &lt;&lt; 32) -- 轉成32-bit補數
		end
		for i = 1, 8 do -- 32-bit 一共8個hex位
			local n = num &amp; 0xF -- 取最低4 bit
			result = hexstr:sub(n + 1, n + 1) .. result
			num = num &gt;&gt; 4 -- 右移4 bit
		end
		return result
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('toHex32')

if not toHex then
	function toHex(num)
		local hexstr = "0123456789ABCDEF"
		local result = ""
		if num &lt; 0 then
			num = (num + (1 &lt;&lt; 64)) % (1 &lt;&lt; 64)  -- 轉成64-bit補數
		end
		for i = 1, 16 do -- 每4 bit 一個 hex字，64-bit總共16個hex位
			local n = num &amp; 0xF -- 取最低4bit
			result = hexstr:sub(n + 1, n + 1) .. result
			num = num &gt;&gt; 4 -- 右移4bit
		end
		return result
	end
end	
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('toHex')
```

```CT
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local isFound = false
  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destionation, quality should not the same if not in 999
  local dupCount = 3

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local currentSequenceAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address

  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  --set Quality address
  --currentQlty = readSmallInteger(srcQualityAddress + 0x06)
  currentQlty = readFloat(srcQualityAddress + 0x08)
  --print("src quality addr: " .. string.format("%08X", srcQualityAddress + 0x06))
  print("src quality: " .. readFloat(srcQualityAddress+ 0x08))
  print("src ID: " .. readSmallInteger(srcQualityAddress))

  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-4, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 8)) -- bypass offset 0-1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 8) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  if (theQuality == 120) then
                    -- do nothing
                  else
                    theQuality = theQuality + i1
                    print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                  end
                else
                  theQuality = 999
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeFloat(currentQualityAddress + 0x8, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt;= 12) -- rest part (quality 2 bytes*2 offset)
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            --currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06)
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0

        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")

local containerBaseAddress = 0
local currentQualityAddress = 0
local f1 = 0
local f2 = 0

synchronize(function() getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick() end)
--A11R_x64_Release.exe+1160268
if (getAddressSafe('A11R_x64_Release.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Please select process A11R_x64_Release.exe first")
else
  containerBaseAddress = getAddressSafe('A11R_x64_Release.exe')+BaseContainerOffset
  currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress
  local isOkay=true
  if (isOkay)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxContainerCount, 1
    do
      currentID = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

      if ( currentID &lt; 0xFFFF)
      then
        if (currentID % 25 == 0)
        then
	      print("NO: " .. i .. ", ID " .. currentID .. ", (addr: " .. string.format("%08X", currentQualityAddress) .. ") set quality to 90." )
        end

        f0 = readFloat(currentQualityAddress + 0x8)
        --if ( i &lt; 50 ) then
          --print(string.format("%08X", currentQualityAddress) .. " .. " .. f0)
        --end
        if ( f0 &lt; 90 ) then
          f0 = 90.5
        end
	    writeFloat(currentQualityAddress + 0x8, f0)
      else
        break
      end
      currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
    end
    print("Done.")
  end

end

-- **デバッグモードの設定 (デフォルト: 無効)**
local debugMode = false

-- AOBScanModule関数
if not AOBScanModule then
    function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
        local baseAddr = nil
        local maxAddr = 0
        local modList

        synchronize(function()
            modList = enumModules()
        end)

        for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
            if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
                baseAddr = mod.Address
                maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
                break
            end
        end

        if not baseAddr then
            if debugMode then print("❗ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!") end
            return nil
        end

        if debugMode then
            print(string.format("✔️ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
            print(string.format("🔬 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))
        end

        local ms = createMemScan()

        synchronize(function()
            ms.firstScan(
                soExactValue,
                vtByteArray,
                nil,
                signature,
                nil,
                baseAddr,
                maxAddr,
                scanOptions or "+X+R",
                fsmNotAligned,
                "1",
                true,
                true,
                false,
                false
            )
        end)

        ms.waitTillDone()

        local results = createFoundList(ms)
        results.initialize()

        local addr
        synchronize(function()
            if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
                addr = results[0]
            end
        end)

        if addr then
            if debugMode then print("🔦 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr) end
        else
            if debugMode then print("💔 AOB not found in " .. moduleName) end
        end

        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    end
end

registerLuaFunctionHighlight('AOBScanModule')

-- AOBScanModuleN関数
if not AOBScanModuleN then
    function AOBScanModuleN(moduleName, signature, maxResults, scanOptions)
        local baseAddr = nil
        local maxAddr = 0
        local modList

        synchronize(function()
            modList = enumModules()
        end)

        for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
            if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
                baseAddr = mod.Address
                maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
                break
            end
        end

        if not baseAddr then
            if debugMode then print("❗ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!") end
            return nil
        end

        if debugMode then
            print(string.format("✔️ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
            print(string.format("🔬 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))
        end

        local ms = createMemScan()

        synchronize(function()
            ms.firstScan(
                soExactValue,
                vtByteArray,
                nil,
                signature,
                nil,
                baseAddr,
                maxAddr,
                scanOptions or "+X+R",
                fsmNotAligned,
                "1",
                true,
                true,
                false,
                false
            )
        end)

        ms.waitTillDone()

        local results = createFoundList(ms)
        results.initialize()

        local addrs = {}
        synchronize(function()
            local count = results.getCount()
            for i = 0, math.min(maxResults - 1, count - 1) do
                table.insert(addrs, results[i])
                if debugMode then
                    print(string.format("🔦 AOB[%d] found at: 0x%s", i + 1, results[i]))
                end
            end
        end)

        if #addrs == 0 and debugMode then
            print("💔 AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        end

        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()

        return addrs
    end
end

if not getProcessNameFromPID then
	function getProcessNameFromPID(pid)
	  local sl = createStringList()
	  getProcessList(sl)
	  local hexPid = string.format("%X", pid):upper()

	  for i = 0, sl.Count - 1 do
		local entry = sl[i]
		local hexid, name = entry:match("^(%x+)%-(.+)$")
		if hexid and name then
		  if tonumber(hexid, 16) == pid then
			return name
		  end
		end
	  end
	  return "(unknown)"
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('getProcessNameFromPID')

if not printProcessInfo then
	function printProcessInfo()
	  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
	  local name = getProcessNameFromPID(pid)
	  print(string.format("📎 Attached to process: %s (PID: %d / 0x%X)", name, pid, pid))
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('printProcessInfo')

if not dumpProcessListAndFindPID then
	function dumpProcessListAndFindPID()
	  local pid = getOpenedProcessID()
	  print(string.format("💭 Current PID: %d / 0x%X", pid, pid))

	  local sl = createStringList()
	  getProcessList(sl)

	  print("🧾 Dumping process list:")
	  for i = 0, sl.Count - 1 do
		local entry = sl[i]
		print(string.format("[%d] %s", i, entry))

		-- 嘗試解析並比對 PID
		local name, hexid = entry:match("(.+)%-(%x+)$")
		if name and hexid then
		  local parsed = tonumber(hexid, 16)
		  if parsed == pid then
			print("🔦 Match found in process list:")
			print(string.format("Name: %s | PID: %s (0x%s)", name, parsed, hexid))
		  end
		end
	  end
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('dumpProcessListAndFindPID')

if not toHex32 then
	function toHex32(num)
		local hexstr = "0123456789ABCDEF"
		local result = ""
		if num &lt; 0 then
			num = (num + (1 &lt;&lt; 32)) % (1 &lt;&lt; 32) -- 轉成32-bit補數
		end
		for i = 1, 8 do -- 32-bit 一共8個hex位
			local n = num &amp; 0xF -- 取最低4 bit
			result = hexstr:sub(n + 1, n + 1) .. result
			num = num &gt;&gt; 4 -- 右移4 bit
		end
		return result
	end
end
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('toHex32')

if not toHex then
	function toHex(num)
		local hexstr = "0123456789ABCDEF"
		local result = ""
		if num &lt; 0 then
			num = (num + (1 &lt;&lt; 64)) % (1 &lt;&lt; 64)  -- 轉成64-bit補數
		end
		for i = 1, 16 do -- 每4 bit 一個 hex字，64-bit總共16個hex位
			local n = num &amp; 0xF -- 取最低4bit
			result = hexstr:sub(n + 1, n + 1) .. result
			num = num &gt;&gt; 4 -- 右移4bit
		end
		return result
	end
end	
registerLuaFunctionHighlight('toHex')
```

```CT
    {name = "gems", aob = "8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 8D 54 24 20 48 8B", pos = 2, aoblen = 6, symbol = "gems_base"},
    {name = "item_serial", aob = "0F B7 1D ?? ?? ?? ?? B8 17 7C 00 00", pos = 3, aoblen = 7, symbol = "item_serial_base"},
  }

  local module_name = 'Atelier_Ryza_2_DX.exe'

  for _, entry in ipairs(AOBs) do
    local aob_addr_str = AOBScanModule(module_name, entry.aob, '+X-C-W')

    if aob_addr_str then
      local aob_addr_val = tonumber(aob_addr_str, 16)
      local offset_addr = aob_addr_val + entry.pos
      local relative_offset = readInteger(offset_addr)
      local final_addr = relative_offset + aob_addr_val + entry.aoblen

      registerSymbol(entry.symbol, final_addr)
      print(string.format("%s registered at: %08X", entry.name, final_addr))
    else
      print(string.format("Warning: AOB scan failed for %s", entry.name))
    end
  end
end

local AOBs = {
  {name = "days", aob = "44 8B 2D ?? ?? ?? ?? 44 8D", pos = 3, aoblen = 7, symbol = "day_base"},
}

local module_name = 'Atelier_Ryza_2_DX.exe'

for _, entry in ipairs(AOBs) do
  local aob_addr_str = AOBScanModule(module_name, entry.aob, '+X-C-W')

  if aob_addr_str then
    local aob_addr_val = tonumber(aob_addr_str, 16)
    local offset_addr = aob_addr_val + entry.pos
    local relative_offset = readInteger(offset_addr)
    local final_addr = relative_offset + aob_addr_val + entry.aoblen

    registerSymbol(entry.symbol, final_addr)
    print(string.format("%s registered at: %08X", entry.name, final_addr))
  else
    print(string.format("Warning: AOB scan failed for %s", entry.name))
  end
end

closeLuaEngine()

  vmovss [x_coords], xmm15
  vmovss xmm15, [rbx+38]
  vmovss [y_coords], xmm15
  vmovss xmm15, [rbx+34]
  vmovss [z_coords], xmm15

  vmovss [backup_coef], xmm15
  vmovss xmm15, [rbx+44]
  vmovss [backup_coef+4], xmm15
  vmovss xmm15, [rbx+48]
  vmovss [backup_coef+8], xmm15

  vmovss xmm15, [speed_acc_factor]

  vmovss xmm14, [rbx+10]
  vmulss xmm14, xmm14, xmm15
  vmovss [rbx+10], xmm14

  // 加速 Y 速度
  vmovss xmm14, [rbx+18]
  vmulss xmm14, xmm14, xmm15
  vmovss [rbx+18], xmm14

  // 加速 Z 速度
  vmovss xmm15, [speed_acc_factor]
  vmovss xmm14, [rbx+14]
  vmulss xmm14, xmm14, xmm15
  vmovss [rbx+14], xmm14

  //vmovss xmm14, [rbx+44]  // Z 係數

            <CheatEntry>
              <ID>21</ID>
              <Description>"Duplicate highlighted item (3x) to container"</Description>
              <Color>FF51A8</Color>
              <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
              <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
--NO_ACTIVATE
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end
print("Start")

-- Check if serial number system is available
local serialBaseAddr = getAddressSafe('item_serial_base')
if not serialBaseAddr then
  print("Error: item_serial_base symbol not found")
  return
end

local itemBaseAddr = readPointer("container_base_addr")
print(string.format("Source item addr: %08X", itemBaseAddr))

if itemBaseAddr == 0 then
  print("Please select item first")
  return
end

if not getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_2_DX.exe') then
  print("Atelier_Ryza_2_DX.exe not found")
  return
end

-- Cache frequently used values
local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress
local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount
local ItemSize = ItemRecordSize
local dupCount = 3
local MAX_SERIAL = 31765  -- Reset threshold
local MAX_QUALITY = 999

print(string.format("Container addr: %08X", containerBaseAddress))

-- Read current serial number from system
local currentSerial = readSmallInteger(serialBaseAddr)
print(string.format("Current serial base: %d", currentSerial))

-- Pre-read source item data once
local srcItemData = readBytes(itemBaseAddr, ItemSize, true)
local srcQuality = readSmallInteger(itemBaseAddr + 0x06)  -- Ryza 2: quality at 0x06

-- Check if source quality is invalid
if srcQuality &gt; MAX_QUALITY then
  print(string.format("Error: Source quality (%d) exceeds maximum (%d)", srcQuality, MAX_QUALITY))
  print("Duplication cancelled")
  return
end

-- Find empty slot
local currentAddr = containerBaseAddress
local emptySlotAddr = nil

for i = 1, MaxCount - 5 do
  local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)
  if currentID == 0xFFFF and i &gt; 1 then
    emptySlotAddr = currentAddr
    print(string.format("Found empty slot #%d at %08X, src quality: %d", i, currentAddr, srcQuality))
    break
  end
  currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
end

if not emptySlotAddr then
  print("No empty slots found")
  return
end

-- Duplicate items with managed serial numbers and quality
local nextSerial = currentSerial
local currentQuality = srcQuality

for i = 0, dupCount - 1 do
  local destAddr = emptySlotAddr + (i * ItemSize)

  -- Write entire item data at once
  writeBytes(destAddr, srcItemData)

  -- Calculate quality for this duplicate
  local newQuality
  if currentQuality &gt;= MAX_QUALITY then
    newQuality = MAX_QUALITY  -- Lock at 999
  else
    newQuality = currentQuality + i
    if newQuality &gt; MAX_QUALITY then
      newQuality = MAX_QUALITY  -- Cap at 999
    end
  end

  -- Assign managed serial number and quality
  writeSmallInteger(destAddr, nextSerial)
  writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x06, newQuality)  -- Quality at 0x06
  writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x08, newQuality)  -- Secondary quality field

  print(string.format("#%d, addr: %08X, Serial: %d, Quality: %d",
    i + 1, destAddr, nextSerial, newQuality))

  nextSerial = nextSerial + 1
end

-- Update serial base or reset if threshold exceeded
if nextSerial &gt; MAX_SERIAL then
  nextSerial = 1
  print(string.format("Serial reset: %d -&gt; 1", nextSerial - 1))
end

writeSmallInteger(serialBaseAddr, nextSerial)
print(string.format("Updated serial base: %d", nextSerial))

print("Done - Duplicated " .. dupCount .. " items")
closeLuaEngine()
{$asm}

  mov ax, [i_min_quality_put_in_container]
  cmp ax, 3E7
  jae check_slots

  cmp dword ptr [is_make_quality_difference], 1
  jne next1

  cmp word ptr [i_seq], 2

  mov word ptr [i_seq], 0

  jbe next1
  mov ax, 3E7

  jne @F

  //*****************************************************************************
  // 特性調整
adjust_crit_percent:

  jne @F
  push rcx
  push rax
  push rdx
  push rsi
  push rdi

  lea rdi, [offset_pairs]
  mov ecx, 3

loop_traits_start:
  // 讀取 word_offset 和 byte_offset
  movzx eax, byte ptr [rdi]      // read trait #1, #2, #3
  movzx edx, word ptr [rbx+rax]  // 讀取 word 值

  lea rsi, [range_table]

check_ranges:
  cmp word ptr [rsi], FFFF
  je skip

  cmp dx, [rsi+0]
  jb next_range
  cmp dx, [rsi+2]
  ja next_range

  // 找到匹配，設置新值
  mov dx, [rsi+4]               // target trait ID
  mov word ptr [rbx+rax], dx

  pop rdi
  movzx eax, byte ptr [rdi+1]   // byte_offset (trait lv)
  mov dl, [rsi+6]               // set to new level
  mov byte ptr [rbx+rax], dl
  push rdi
  jmp skip

next_range:
  add rsi, 8
  jmp check_ranges

skip:
  pop rdi
  add rdi, 2  // 下一對 offset
  dec ecx
  jnz loop_traits_start

  pop rdi
  pop rsi
  pop rdx
  pop rax
  pop rcx
  jmp after_range_table

  local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)

  -- Break if empty slot found
  if currentID == 0xFFFF then
    print(string.format("%d item(s) processed, %d item(s) changed.", processedCount, modifiedCount))
    break
  end

  processedCount = processedCount + 1

  -- Check and update quality if below target

  if currentQuality &lt; targetQuality then
    writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06, targetQuality)
    writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x08, targetQuality)  -- Secondary quality field
    modifiedCount = modifiedCount + 1

    -- Print first few modifications for verification
    if modifiedCount &lt;= 5 then
      print(string.format("Item #%d (ID:%d): %d -&gt; %d", i, currentID, currentQuality, targetQuality))
    end
  end

  currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
end

    print(string.format("%d item(s) processed, %d item(s) changed.", processedCount, modifiedCount))
    break

  processedCount = processedCount + 1

  -- Check and update quality if below target
  local currentQuality = readSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06)  -- Ryza 2: quality at 0x06
  if currentQuality &lt; targetQuality then
    writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06, targetQuality)
    writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x08, targetQuality)  -- Secondary quality field
    modifiedCount = modifiedCount + 1

    -- Print first few modifications for verification
    if modifiedCount &lt;= 5 then
      print(string.format("Basket item #%d (ID:%d): %d -&gt; %d", i, currentID, currentQuality, targetQuality))
    end
  end

[ENABLE]
print('Basket quality auto-set: Enabled')

TimerB1 = createTimer()
TimerB1.Interval = 10000  -- 10 seconds

TimerB1.OnTimer = function(timer)
  if not getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_2_DX.exe') then
    return  -- Game not loaded, skip
  end

  -- Cache frequently used values
  local basketBaseAddress = g_basketBaseAddress
  local dynBasketAddress = g_dynBasketAddress
  local ItemSize = ItemRecordSize
  local targetQuality = readSmallInteger('new_basket_item_quality')

  if not targetQuality or targetQuality == 0 then
    return  -- No valid target quality set
  end

  local maxBasketCount = readSmallInteger(dynBasketAddress)
  local currentAddr = basketBaseAddress
  local usedSlots = 0
  local modifiedCount = 0

  -- Process all basket items
  for i = 1, maxBasketCount do
    local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)

    if currentID == 0xFFFF then
      break  -- Reached empty slots
    end

    usedSlots = usedSlots + 1

    -- Check and update quality
    local currentQuality = readSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06)  -- Ryza 2: quality at 0x06
    if currentQuality &lt; targetQuality then
      writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06, targetQuality)
      writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x08, targetQuality)  -- Secondary quality field
      modifiedCount = modifiedCount + 1
    end

    currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
  end

  -- Update basket space indicator (if exists)
  local basketSpaceLeft = maxBasketCount - usedSlots
  local spaceLeftAddr = readSmallInteger("basket_space_left")
  if spaceLeftAddr and spaceLeftAddr ~= 0 then
    writeSmallInteger("basket_space_left", basketSpaceLeft)
  end

  -- Optional: Print status (comment out if too verbose)
  -- if modifiedCount &gt; 0 then
  --   print(string.format("[Timer] Modified %d/%d basket items to quality %d",
  --     modifiedCount, usedSlots, targetQuality))
  -- end
end

[DISABLE]
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end

if TimerB1 then
  TimerB1.Destroy()
  TimerB1 = nil
end

  <LuaScript>MaxContainerCount = 9999
MaxBasketCount = 300

g_containerBaseAddress = nil

ItemRecordSize = 100

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end
end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {290, 9999999,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence

function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("%s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```ps1
.\Extract_ID2 'D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 2 DX\Data\saves\text_kr\str_item_name.xml' 'D:\Github\Mydev-Cheat-Engine-Tables\Atelier Ryza 2 Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX\kr_str_name.csv'
.\Extract_ID2 'D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 2 DX\Data\saves\text_kr\str_item_effect.xml' 'D:\Github\Mydev-Cheat-Engine-Tables\Atelier Ryza 2 Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX\kr_str_item_effect.csv'
.\Extract_ID2 'D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 2 DX\Data\saves\text_kr\str_item_potential.xml' 'D:\Github\Mydev-Cheat-Engine-Tables\Atelier Ryza 2 Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX\kr_str_item_potential.csv'

# ID is relative offset from first item ID (curr_ID - first_ID) in 4-digit hexadecimal format
[CmdletBinding()]
Param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$InputFile,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$OutputFile
)

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $InputFile -PathType Leaf)) {
    Throw "輸入檔案不存在！"
}

if (Test-Path -Path $OutputFile -PathType Leaf) {
    Throw "輸出檔案已存在！"
}

if (-not (Test-Path -Path (Split-Path -Path $OutputFile) -PathType Container)) {
    Throw "輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"
}

# 讀取 XML 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$xml = [xml](Get-Content -Path $InputFile -Encoding UTF8)

# 初始化結果陣列
$results = @()

# 取得第一筆資料的 String_No 作為基準值
$firstItem = $xml.Root.str | Select-Object -First 1
if ($null -eq $firstItem) {
    Throw "XML 檔案中沒有資料！"
}

# 從 String_No 中提取數字部分作為基準
$baseId = [int]($firstItem.String_No -replace '\D')

# 提取每一筆資料
foreach ($item in $xml.Root.str) {
    # 從 String_No 中提取數字部分
    $currentId = [int]($item.String_No -replace '\D')
    
    # 計算相對於第一筆的偏移量
    $offset = $currentId - $baseId
    
    # 取得 Text 的內容
    $text = $item.Text
    
    # 將偏移量轉換為 4 位 16 進位格式（大寫）
    $hexOffset = "{0:X4}" -f $offset
    
    # 組合成 "XXXX:文字" 格式
    $line = "${hexOffset}:${text}"
    
    # 將結果加入結果陣列
    $results += $line
}

# 將結果陣列輸出成文字檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$results | Out-File -FilePath $OutputFile -Encoding UTF8
```

```CT
end
```

```CT
        local isCompactMode = not (compactViewMenuItem.Caption == 'Compact View Mode')
        if forceEnable ~= nil then
            isCompactMode = not forceEnable
        end

    synchronize(function()
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = isCompactMode and 'Compact View Mode' or 'Full View Mode'
        getMainForm().Splitter1.Visible = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel4.Visible    = isCompactMode
        getMainForm().Panel5.Visible    = isCompactMode
    end)
end
end

    function createCompactViewMenu()
        if isCompactMenuCreated then return end

    synchronize(function()
        local mainMenu = getMainForm().Menu.Items
        compactViewMenuItem = createMenuItem(mainMenu)
        mainMenu.add(compactViewMenuItem)
        compactViewMenuItem.Caption = 'Compact View Mode'
        compactViewMenuItem.OnClick = toggleCompactView
    end)

    isCompactMenuCreated = true
end

    local aob_addr_val = tonumber(aob_addr_str, 16)

    --print(a1 .. " addr: " .. string.format("%08X", final_addr_val))
    registerSymbol(a5, final_addr_val)
    --print('-------')
  end
end

itemBaseAddr=readPointer("container_base_addr") --higlighted item base addr

if (itemBaseAddr == 0) then
  print("Please select item first")
  return
end
```
