```CT
--getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_2.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Atelier_Ryza_2.exe?")
else
  --Author : bbfox@ https://opencheattables.com/
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local isFound = false
  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destionation, quality should not the same if not in 999
  local dupCount = 3

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  --set Quality address
  currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06)

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)
        --print("currentQualityAddress #", string.format("%08X", currentQualityAddress))
        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item serial
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end

              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 6)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 6) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
                --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 7) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

aobscanmodule(INJECT_BATTLE_HP,$process,29 83 0C 01 00 00) // should be unique
alloc(newmem,$1000,INJECT_BATTLE_HP)

label(code)
label(return)
label(hp_damage_type)
label(enemy_damage_multi)
label(hp_fdamage_multi)

  cmp [rbx+0000010C+4], 0
  je its_enemy
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 0 // off
  je orig_code
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 1 // 1pt
  je one_damage
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 2 // No damage
  je zero_damage

half_damage_or_more:
  // Half
  cmp eax, 1
  je orig_code

  cmp [hp_damage_type], 3
  jne orig_code
  //3:by multiplier
  vmovss xmm14, [hp_fdamage_multi]
  cvtsi2ss xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15

  jmp orig_code

one_damage:
  mov eax, 1
  jmp orig_code
zero_damage:
  mov eax, 0
  jmp orig_code

its_enemy:
  vmovss xmm15, [vf_1]
  vmovss xmm14, [enemy_damage_multi]
  vcomiss xmm14, xmm15
  je orig_code

  cvtsi2ss xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15


orig_code:
code:
  sub [rbx+0000010C],eax

  enemy_damage_multi:
  dd (float)1
  vf_1:
  dd (float)1

INJECT_BATTLE_HP:
  jmp newmem
  nop
return:

  end
  currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + 100 -- 0x64 bytes per item
end

        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()

--determine event trigger sequence


function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```CT
    {name = "difficult", ["aob"]="8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 39 43 20", ["pos"]= 2,  ["aoblen"]= 6 , ["symbol"]="difficult_base"},
    {name = "cole", ["aob"]="89 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 85 DB 74 11", ["pos"]= 2,  ["aoblen"]= 6 , ["symbol"]="cole_base"},
    {name = "gems", ["aob"]="8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 8D 54 24 20 48 8B", ["pos"]= 2,  ["aoblen"]= 6 , ["symbol"]="gems_base"},
    {name = "SPs", ["aob"]="29 1D ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 83 C4 20 5B C3", ["pos"]= 2,  ["aoblen"]= 6 , ["symbol"]="sp_base"},
    {name = "puni_lv", aob = "48 8D 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 69 CB 28 0C 00 00", pos = 3, aoblen = 7, symbol = "puni_lv_base"},
    {name = "puni_data", aob = "4C 8D 35 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 69 D0 28 0C 00 00", pos = 3, aoblen = 7, symbol = "puni_data_base"},
    {name = "item_serial", aob = "0F B7 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? B9 17 7C 00 00", pos = 3, aoblen = 7, symbol = "item_serial_base"},
    {name = "weather", aob = "8B 1D ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 89 AC 24 88 00 00 00 E8", pos = 2, aoblen = 6, symbol = "weather_base"},
    {name = "minutes", aob = "8B 0D ?? ?? ?? ?? B8 89 88 88 88", pos = 2, aoblen = 6, symbol = "minutes_base"},
  }

  local module_name = 'Atelier_Ryza_3_DX.exe'

  for _, entry in ipairs(AOBs) do
    local aob_addr_str = AOBScanModule(module_name, entry.aob, '+X-C-W')

    if aob_addr_str then
      local aob_addr_val = tonumber(aob_addr_str, 16)
      local offset_addr = aob_addr_val + entry.pos
      local relative_offset = readInteger(offset_addr)
      local final_addr = relative_offset + aob_addr_val + entry.aoblen

      registerSymbol(entry.symbol, final_addr)
      print(string.format("%s registered at: %08X", entry.name, final_addr))
    else
      print(string.format("Warning: AOB scan failed for %s", entry.name))
    end
  end
end

[ENABLE]

aobscanmodule(INJECT_BATTLE_END_HP,$process,89 74 9F 10 85 DB) // should be unique
alloc(newmem,$1000,INJECT_BATTLE_END_HP)

label(code)
label(return)
label(i_1st_HP_addr)

newmem:
  cmp rbx, 0
  jne code
  push r15
  cmp qword ptr [i_1st_HP_addr], 0
  jne next1
  lea r15, [rdi+rbx*4+10]
  mov [i_1st_HP_addr], r15

next1:
  mov r15d, [rdi+rbx*4+10+100]
  mov esi, r15d
  pop r15

code:
  mov [rdi+rbx*4+10],esi
  test ebx,ebx
  jmp return
align 10 cc
  i_1st_HP_addr:
  dq 0
INJECT_BATTLE_END_HP:
  jmp newmem
  nop
return:
registersymbol(INJECT_BATTLE_END_HP)
registersymbol(i_1st_HP_addr)

[DISABLE]

INJECT_BATTLE_END_HP:
  db 89 74 9F 10 85 DB

unregistersymbol(*)
dealloc(newmem)

--[[
================================================================================
Item Duplication Script for Atelier Ryza 3 DX
================================================================================
Author: bbfox @ https://opencheattables.com/
Version: 3.0
Last Updated: 2025-12-22

DESCRIPTION:
  Duplicates selected item 3 times with managed serial numbers and quality.
  Supports both normal items and special replicable keys with different rules.

FEATURES:
  - Automatic serial number management with hard cap at 32267
  - Quality increment for normal items (caps at 999)
  - Special handling for replicable keys (quality must be 0xFFFF)
  - Protected item ranges (Important Items, Pristine Keys)
  - Error messages written to memory (str_msg1/2/3) with timestamps
  - Message buffers cleared before each run

ITEM TYPES:
  1. Normal Items:
     - Quality range: 0-999
     - Quality increments by 1 for each duplicate
     - Serial number managed via item_serial_base

  2. Replicable Keys:
     - Item ID range: 0x20E - 0x241
     - Must be in Container (0x3A94 items) or Basket (0x2BB items) range
     - Quality must be 0xFFFF at both offset +0x06 and +0x08
     - Quality remains 0xFFFF after duplication
     - Serial number managed same as normal items

PROTECTED RANGES:
  - Important Items: g_importantBaseAddress + (0x80 × 0x64)
  - Pristine Keys: g_pristineKeyAddress + (0x80 × 0x20)

SERIAL NUMBER MANAGEMENT:
  - Reads from: item_serial_base symbol
  - Range: 0 - 32267 (hard cap)
  - Increments by 1 for each duplicate
  - Locks at 32267 when cap is reached

ERROR HANDLING:
  All errors write to memory symbols and console:
  - str_msg1: Error type
  - str_msg2: Error details
  - str_msg3: Timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)

REQUIREMENTS:
  - Atelier_Ryza_3_DX.exe loaded
  - Symbols: container_base_addr, item_serial_base, str_msg1/2/3
  - Global variables: g_containerBaseAddress, g_basketBaseAddress,
                      g_importantBaseAddress, g_pristineKeyAddress,
                      MaxContainerCount, ItemRecordSize

USAGE:
  1. Enable item editor, select an item in-game
  2. Run this script
  3. Check console output or str_msg symbols for results

NOTES:
  - Message buffers (str_msg1/2/3) are cleared at script start
  - All operations logged to both console and memory
  - Script auto-closes LuaEngine on completion or error
================================================================================
--]]


print("Start")

-- Helper function to write message to memory with null termination
local function writeMessage(address, message)
  if not address then return end

  local MAX_MSG_LENGTH = 60
  -- Truncate message if too long (reserve 1 byte for null)
  if #message &gt;= MAX_MSG_LENGTH then
    message = message:sub(1, MAX_MSG_LENGTH - 1)
  end

  -- Write message string
  writeString(address, message)

  -- Ensure null termination
  writeByte(address + #message, 0)
end

-- Helper function to clear message buffer
local function clearMessage(address)
  if not address then return end
  -- Write null at start to clear the string
  writeByte(address, 0)
end

local function writeTimestamp(tsAddr)
  local timestamp = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  writeMessage(tsAddr, timestamp)
  closeLuaEngine()
end

-- Helper function to write error messages (also prints to console)
local function writeError(msg1Addr, msg2Addr, msg3Addr, errorMsg1, errorMsg2)
  -- Print to console
  if errorMsg1 then
    print(errorMsg1)
  end
  if errorMsg2 then
    print(errorMsg2)
  end

  -- Write to memory
  if msg1Addr then
    writeMessage(msg1Addr, errorMsg1 or "")
  end
  if msg2Addr then
    writeMessage(msg2Addr, errorMsg2 or "")
  end
  if msg3Addr then
    -- Write timestamp
    local timestamp = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    writeMessage(msg3Addr, timestamp)
    print("Timestamp: " .. timestamp)
  end

  closeLuaEngine()
end

if not getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_3_DX.exe') then
  writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
    "Error: Game not found",
    "Atelier_Ryza_3_DX.exe not loaded")
  return
end

-- Cache frequently used values
local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress
local basketBaseAddress = g_basketBaseAddress
local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount
local ItemSize = ItemRecordSize
local dupCount = 3
local MAX_QUALITY = 999
local MAX_SERIAL = 32267  -- Hard cap at 32267 (in game logic is 31767)

-- Key-specific constants
local KEY_ID_MIN = 0x20E
local KEY_ID_MAX = 0x241
local KEY_QUALITY_VALUE = 0xFFFF
local CONTAINER_KEY_COUNT = 0x3A94 -- 14996
local BASKET_KEY_COUNT = 0x2BB -- 699

-- Get message buffer addresses
local msgAddr1 = getAddressSafe('str_msg1')
local msgAddr2 = getAddressSafe('str_msg2')
local msgAddr3 = getAddressSafe('str_msg3')
local timestampAddr = getAddressSafe('str_timestamp')
--writeTimestamp(timestampAddr)
writeMessage(timestampAddr, ".")

-- Clear message buffers at start
print("Clearing message buffers...")
clearMessage(msgAddr1)
clearMessage(msgAddr2)
clearMessage(msgAddr3)

-- Check if container base address is available
local containerBaseAddr = getAddressSafe('container_base_addr')
if not containerBaseAddr then
  writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
    "Error: container_base_addr symbol not found",
    "Cannot proceed without container address")
  return
end

-- Check if serial number system is available
local serialBaseAddr = getAddressSafe('item_serial_base')
if not serialBaseAddr then
  writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
    "Error: item_serial_base symbol not found",
    "Cannot proceed without serial base")
  return
end

local itemBaseAddr = readPointer("container_base_addr")
print(string.format("Source item addr: %08X", itemBaseAddr))

if itemBaseAddr == 0 then
  writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
    "Error: No item selected",
    "Please select an item first")
  return
end

-- **Check if source is in protected address ranges**
local importantBaseAddr = g_importantBaseAddress
local pristineKeyAddr = g_pristineKeyAddress
local IMPORTANT_COUNT = 0x64  -- 100 items
local PRISTINE_KEY_COUNT = 0x20  -- 32 keys

-- Check important items range
if importantBaseAddr then
  local importantRangeStart = importantBaseAddr
  local importantRangeEnd = importantBaseAddr + (ItemSize * IMPORTANT_COUNT)

  if itemBaseAddr &gt;= importantRangeStart and itemBaseAddr &lt; importantRangeEnd then
    print(string.format("Protected range: %08X - %08X", importantRangeStart, importantRangeEnd))
    writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
      "Error: Protected item",
      "Cannot duplicate important items")
    --writeTimestamp(timestampAddr)
    return
  end
end

-- Check pristine key (equipped keys in keyring) range
--[[
if pristineKeyAddr then
  local pristineRangeStart = pristineKeyAddr
  local pristineRangeEnd = pristineKeyAddr + (0x80 * PRISTINE_KEY_COUNT)

  if itemBaseAddr &gt;= pristineRangeStart and itemBaseAddr &lt; pristineRangeEnd then
    print(string.format("Protected range: %08X - %08X", pristineRangeStart, pristineRangeEnd))
    writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
      "Error: Protected item",
      "Cannot duplicate equpiied keys in keyring")
    return
  end
end
]]--

print(string.format("Container addr: %08X", containerBaseAddress))

-- Read current serial base
local currentSerialBase = readSmallInteger(serialBaseAddr)
print(string.format("Current serial base: %d", currentSerialBase))

-- Pre-read source item data
local srcItemData = readBytes(itemBaseAddr, ItemSize, true)
local srcItemID = readSmallInteger(itemBaseAddr + 0x04)  -- Item ID at offset +0x02
local srcQuality = readSmallInteger(itemBaseAddr + 0x06)
local srcQuality2 = readSmallInteger(itemBaseAddr + 0x08)

print(string.format("Source Item ID: %03X", srcItemID))
print(string.format("Source quality: %d (0x%04X)", srcQuality, srcQuality))

-- **Determine if this is a replicable Key**
local isKey = false
local containerKeyRangeStart = containerBaseAddress
local containerKeyRangeEnd = containerBaseAddress + (ItemSize * CONTAINER_KEY_COUNT)
local basketKeyRangeStart = basketBaseAddress
local basketKeyRangeEnd = basketBaseAddress + (ItemSize * BASKET_KEY_COUNT)

if srcItemID &gt;= KEY_ID_MIN and srcItemID &lt;= KEY_ID_MAX then
  -- Check if in valid key address ranges
  if (itemBaseAddr &gt;= containerKeyRangeStart and itemBaseAddr &lt; containerKeyRangeEnd) or
     (itemBaseAddr &gt;= basketKeyRangeStart and itemBaseAddr &lt; basketKeyRangeEnd) then
    isKey = true
    print(string.format("Detected as replicable Key (ID: 0x%03X)", srcItemID))
  end
end

-- **Quality validation based on item type**
if isKey then
  -- Key must have quality 0xFFFF
  if srcQuality ~= KEY_QUALITY_VALUE or srcQuality2 ~= KEY_QUALITY_VALUE then
    writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
      string.format("Error: Invalid Key quality (0x%04X, 0x%04X)", srcQuality, srcQuality2),
      "Key quality must be 0xFFFF")
    return
  end
  print("Key quality validation passed (0xFFFF)")
else
  -- Normal item must have quality &lt;= 999
  if srcQuality &gt; MAX_QUALITY then
    writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
      string.format("Error: Invalid quality (%d)", srcQuality),
      string.format("Maximum allowed is %d", MAX_QUALITY))
    return
  end
  if srcQuality2 &gt; MAX_QUALITY then
    writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
      string.format("Error: Invalid quality #2 (%d)", srcQuality2),
      string.format("Maximum allowed is %d", MAX_QUALITY))
    return
  end
end

-- **Find empty slot**
local currentAddr = containerBaseAddress
local emptySlotAddr = nil

for i = 1, MaxCount - 5 do
  local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)
  if currentID == 0xFFFF and i &gt; 1 then
    emptySlotAddr = currentAddr
    print(string.format("Found empty slot #%d at %08X", i, currentAddr))
    break
  end
  currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
end

if not emptySlotAddr then
  writeError(msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3,
    "Error: Container full",
    "No empty slots available")
  return
end

-- **Duplicate items with managed serial numbers and quality**
local currentQuality = srcQuality
local msgAddresses = {msgAddr1, msgAddr2, msgAddr3}
local nextSerial = currentSerialBase

-- Check if already at or above max - cap it
if currentSerialBase &gt;= MAX_SERIAL then
  print(string.format("Serial base at/above cap (%d), locked at %d", currentSerialBase, MAX_SERIAL))
  nextSerial = MAX_SERIAL
  writeSmallInteger(serialBaseAddr, MAX_SERIAL)
end

for i = 0, dupCount - 1 do
  local destAddr = emptySlotAddr + (i * ItemSize)

  -- Write entire item data at once
  writeBytes(destAddr, srcItemData)

  -- Assign serial number
  writeSmallInteger(destAddr, nextSerial)

  -- Handle quality based on item type
  local newQuality
  if isKey then
    -- Key: always use 0xFFFF
    writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x06, KEY_QUALITY_VALUE)
    writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x08, KEY_QUALITY_VALUE)
    newQuality = KEY_QUALITY_VALUE
    print(string.format("Key #%d, addr: %08X, Serial: %d, Quality: 0x%04X",
      i + 1, destAddr, nextSerial, newQuality))
  else
    -- Normal item: calculate quality with increment
    if currentQuality &gt;= MAX_QUALITY then
      newQuality = MAX_QUALITY  -- Lock at 999
    else
      newQuality = currentQuality + i
      if newQuality &gt; MAX_QUALITY then
        newQuality = MAX_QUALITY  -- Cap at 999
      end
    end
    writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x06, newQuality)
    writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x08, newQuality)
    print(string.format("Item #%d, addr: %08X, Serial: %d, Quality: %d",
      i + 1, destAddr, nextSerial, newQuality))
  end

  -- Create message for memory
  local message
  if isKey then
    message = string.format("#%d, addr: %08X, Serial: %d, Quality: 0xFFFF",
      i + 1, destAddr, nextSerial)
  else
    message = string.format("#%d, addr: %08X, Serial: %d, Quality: %d",
      i + 1, destAddr, nextSerial, newQuality)
  end

  -- Write to corresponding symbol address
  writeMessage(msgAddresses[i + 1], message)
  writeTimestamp(timestampAddr)

  -- Increment serial only if below cap
  if nextSerial &lt; MAX_SERIAL then
    nextSerial = nextSerial + 1
  end
end

-- Update serial base (will stay at MAX_SERIAL if at cap)
writeSmallInteger(serialBaseAddr, nextSerial)
print(string.format("Updated serial base: %d", nextSerial))

if isKey then
  print("Done - Duplicated " .. dupCount .. " keys")
else
  print("Done - Duplicated " .. dupCount .. " items")
end
closeLuaEngine()

  vcomiss xmm14, xmm15

label(i_last_store_item_in_container_addr is_raise_key_effect)
label(is_make_quality_difference is_open_all_slots is_reset_item_level)
label(is_adjust_crit_p is_assign_quality_traits)
label(is_fill_empty_effects is_assign_super_trait)

newmem:

  push rax
  xor rax, rax
{ $try}
  test rbx, rbx
  jz endp

  // ******* quality set: jitter
  cmp word ptr [rbx+6], 0  // quality is 0
  je endp

  mov ax, [rbx+6]
  cmp ax, [i_min_quality_put_in_container]
  jae check_slots
  mov ax, [i_min_quality_put_in_container]
  cmp ax, 3E7
  jae check_slots

  // keep quality not the same (jitter)
  cmp dword ptr [is_make_quality_difference], 1
  jne next1

  inc word ptr [i_seq]
  cmp word ptr [i_seq], 2
  jbe next0
  mov word ptr [i_seq], 0
next0:

  add ax, word ptr [i_seq]
  cmp ax, 3E7
  jbe next1
  mov ax, 3E7

next1:
  mov [rbx+6], ax
  mov [rbx+8], ax

  // force trait slots enabled
check_slots: // num of slots open
  cmp dword ptr [is_open_all_slots], 1
  jne @F

  and byte ptr [rbx+3], 87 // 10000111b

  // *********** reset item level
check_level:
  cmp dword ptr [is_reset_item_level], 1
  jne @F

  cmp byte ptr [rbx+A], 5
  jbe @F
  mov byte ptr [rbx+A], 5

chk_reduce_cc:
  cmp dword ptr [is_modify_cc], 1
  jne @F

  mov byte ptr [rbx+C], -A

  // *********** not used
chk_remove_enforced: // not confirmed
  cmp dword ptr [is_remove_enforced], 1
  jne @F

chk_assign_effects:

  jne after_chk_assign_effects
  cmp word ptr [rbx+1C], FFFF
  jne @F
  mov word ptr [rbx+1C], 8BB   // add fire element

@@:
  cmp word ptr [rbx+1E], FFFF
  jne @F
  mov word ptr [rbx+1E], 8BC   // add ice element

@@:
  cmp word ptr [rbx+20], FFFF
  jne @F
  mov word ptr [rbx+20], 8BD   // add thunder element

@@:
  cmp word ptr [rbx+22], FFFF
  jne @F
  mov word ptr [rbx+22], 8BE   // add wind element

  jne @F
  mov word ptr [rbx+14], 2
  mov byte ptr [rbx+F], 32

  jne after_assign_super_trait

  cmp word ptr [rbx+4], 18A

  movzx edx, word ptr [rbx+rax]  // 讀取 word 值

{$lua}
--NO_ACTIVATE
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end
clearLuaLog()
print("Start")

if not getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_3_DX.exe') then
  print("Atelier_Ryza_3_DX.exe not found")
  return
end

-- Cache frequently used values
local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress
local ItemSize = ItemRecordSize
local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount
local targetQuality = readSmallInteger('new_item_quality')

print(string.format("Container addr: %08X", containerBaseAddress))
print(string.format("Target quality: %d", targetQuality))

local currentAddr = containerBaseAddress
local processedCount = 0
local modifiedCount = 0

for i = 1, MaxCount do
  local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)

  -- Break if empty slot found
  if currentID == 0xFFFF then
    print(string.format("%d item(s) processed, %d item(s) changed.", processedCount, modifiedCount))
    break
  end

  processedCount = processedCount + 1

  -- Check and update quality if below target
  local currentQuality = readSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06)
  if currentQuality &lt; targetQuality then
    writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x06, targetQuality)
    writeSmallInteger(currentAddr + 0x08, targetQuality)  -- Secondary quality field
    modifiedCount = modifiedCount + 1

    -- Print first few modifications for verification
    if modifiedCount &lt;= 5 then
      print(string.format("Item #%d (ID:%d): %d -&gt; %d", i, currentID, currentQuality, targetQuality))
    end
  end

  currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
end

print("Done")
closeLuaEngine()

-- Pristine key template data (128 bytes)
-- 效果3: 0D77 : 製作鑰匙數量增加+3 (0x77, 0x0D) -- Bytes 32-47
--         調整為 0920 : 使用次數增加+6 (0x20, 0x09)
local pristineKeyTemplate = {
  -- Bytes 0-15
  0xFF, 0xFF, 0x01, 0x84, 0x2A, 0x04, 0xE7, 0x03, 0xE7, 0x03, 0x1E, 0x1E, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01,

  -- Bytes 32-47
  0x20, 0x09, 0x78, 0x0D, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x05, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
  -- Bytes 48-63
  0x04, 0x06, 0x03, 0x04, 0x04, 0x05, 0x05, 0x06, 0x06, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03, 0x04, 0x04, 0x05,

}

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end
end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {412, 9999999,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence

function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("%s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```ps1
#>

# ID is relative offset from first item ID (curr_ID - first_ID) in 4-digit hexadecimal format
[CmdletBinding()]
Param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$InputFile,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$OutputFile
)

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $InputFile -PathType Leaf)) {
    Throw "輸入檔案不存在！"
}

if (Test-Path -Path $OutputFile -PathType Leaf) {
    Throw "輸出檔案已存在！"
}

if (-not (Test-Path -Path (Split-Path -Path $OutputFile) -PathType Container)) {
    Throw "輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"
}

# 讀取 XML 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$xml = [xml](Get-Content -Path $InputFile -Encoding UTF8)

# 初始化結果陣列
$results = @()

# 取得第一筆資料的 String_No 作為基準值
$firstItem = $xml.Root.str | Select-Object -First 1
if ($null -eq $firstItem) {
    Throw "XML 檔案中沒有資料！"
}

# 從 String_No 中提取數字部分作為基準
$baseId = [int]($firstItem.String_No -replace '\D')

# 提取每一筆資料
foreach ($item in $xml.Root.str) {
    # 從 String_No 中提取數字部分
    $currentId = [int]($item.String_No -replace '\D')
    
    # 計算相對於第一筆的偏移量
    $offset = $currentId - $baseId
    
    # 取得 Text 的內容
    $text = $item.Text
    
    # 將偏移量轉換為 4 位 16 進位格式（大寫）
    $hexOffset = "{0:X4}" -f $offset
    
    # 組合成 "XXXX:文字" 格式
    $line = "${hexOffset}:${text}"
    
    # 將結果加入結果陣列
    $results += $line
}

# 將結果陣列輸出成文字檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$results | Out-File -FilePath $OutputFile -Encoding UTF8
```

```CT
if syntaxcheck then return end

print("Source item addr: " .. string.format("%08X", itemBaseAddr))
if (itemBaseAddr == 0) then
  print("Please select item first")
  return
end

srcQualityAddress = itemBaseAddr

--getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_3.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Atelier_Ryza_3.exe?")
else
  --Author : bbfox@ https://opencheattables.com/
  --local containerBaseAddress = getAddressSafe("Atelier_Ryza_3.exe")+0x?????
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local isFound = false
  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destionation, quality should not the same if not in 999
  local dupCount = 3

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local currentSequenceAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address

  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  --set Quality address
  --currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06)
  currentQlty = readSmallInteger(srcQualityAddress + 0x06)
  --print("src quality addr: " .. string.format("%08X", srcQualityAddress + 0x06))
  print("src quality: " .. readSmallInteger(srcQualityAddress+ 0x06))
  print("src ID: " .. readSmallInteger(srcQualityAddress))


  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)
        --currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentSequenceAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 6)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = 999
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x8, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 9) -- rest part (quality 2 bytes*2 offset)
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            --currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06)
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0

        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

  je its_enemy
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 0 // off
  je orig_code
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 1 // 1pt
  je one_damage
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 2 // No damage
  je zero_damage

half_damage_or_more:
  // Half
  cmp eax, 1
  je orig_code

  cmp [hp_damage_type], 3
  jne orig_code
  //3:by multiplier
  vmovss xmm14, [hp_fdamage_multi]
  cvtsi2ss xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15

  jmp orig_code

one_damage:
  mov eax, 1
  jmp orig_code
zero_damage:
  mov eax, 0
  jmp orig_code

its_enemy:
  vmovss xmm15, [vf_1]
  vmovss xmm14, [enemy_damage_multi]
  vcomiss xmm14, xmm15
  je orig_code

  cvtsi2ss xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15

  sub [rbx+0000010C],eax

  enemy_damage_multi:
  dd (float)1.001
  vf_1:
  dd (float)1

INJECT_BATTLE_HP:
  jmp newmem
  nop
return:

  print('new quality: '..TargetQuality)


  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
  local i
  local i1 = 0

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount, 1
    do
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)
        if (currentID0 ~= 65535 and i &gt;= 1)
        then
          currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06)
          if (currentQlty &lt; TargetQuality) then
            i1 = i1 + 1
            writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x06, TargetQuality)
            writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x08, TargetQuality)
          end
        else
          print((i-1) .. " item(s) processed, " .. (i1) .. " item(s) changed.")
          break
        end
        prevID0 = currentID0
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {41, 158, 208,

--determine event trigger sequence


function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

`Atelier Ryza 3/Extract_ID.ps1`:

```ps1
# https://github.com/bbfox0703/Mydev-Cheat-Engine-Tables
#
# JA
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_jp\str_monster_name.xml" .\str_monster_name_ja.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_jp\str_fm_landmark.xml" .\str_fm_landmark_ja.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_jp\str_item_name.xml" .\str_item_name_ja.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_jp\str_item_potential.xml" .\str_item_potential_ja.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_jp\str_item_effect.xml" .\str_item_effect_ja.csv
#
# TC
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_tc\str_monster_name.xml" .\str_monster_name_tc.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_tc\str_fm_landmark.xml" .\str_fm_landmark_tc.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_tc\str_item_name.xml" .\str_item_name_tc.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_tc\str_item_potential.xml" .\str_item_potential_tc.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_tc\str_item_effect.xml" .\str_item_effect_tc.csv
#
# EN
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_en\str_monster_name.xml" .\str_monster_name_en.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_en\str_fm_landmark.xml" .\str_fm_landmark_en.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_en\str_item_name.xml" .\str_item_name_en.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_en\str_item_potential.xml" .\str_item_potential_en.csv
# ./Extract_ID.ps1 "E:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza 3\Data\saves\text_en\str_item_effect.xml" .\str_item_effect_en.csv


[CmdletBinding()]
Param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$InputFile,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$OutputFile
)

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $InputFile -PathType Leaf)) {
	# Throw "Input file not exist!"
    Throw "輸入檔案不存在！"
	# throw [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("輸入檔案不存在！"))
}

if (Test-Path -Path $OutputFile -PathType Leaf) {
	# Throw "Output file exist!"
    Throw "輸出檔案已存在！"
	# throw [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("輸出檔案已存在！"))
}

if (-not (Test-Path -Path (Split-Path -Path $OutputFile) -PathType Container)) {
	# Throw "Output directory not exist!"
    Throw "輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"
	# throw [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"))
}

# 讀取 XML 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$xml = [xml](Get-Content -Path  $inputFile -Encoding UTF8)

# 初始化結果陣列
$results = @()

# 提取每一筆資料
foreach ($item in $xml.Root.str) {
    # 從 String_ID 中提取數字部分
    $idNumber = $item.String_ID -replace '\D+(\d+)$', '$1'
    # 取得 Text 的內容
    $text = $item.Text

    # 組合成結果物件
    $result = New-Object PSObject -Property @{
        ID = $idNumber
        Text = $text
    }

    # 將結果物件加入結果陣列
    $results += $result
}

# 將結果陣列輸出成 CSV 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$results | Export-Csv -Path  $outputFile -Encoding UTF8 -NoTypeInformation
```

```CT
    end

{$lua}
--NO_ACTIVATE
if syntaxcheck then return end
if memrec then print(memrec.Description) end
print("Start")

local itemBaseAddr = readPointer("container_base_addr")
print(string.format("Source item addr: %08X", itemBaseAddr))

if itemBaseAddr == 0 then
  print("Please select item first")
  return
end

if not getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza_DX.exe') then
  print("Atelier_Ryza_DX.exe not found")
  return
end

-- Cache frequently used values
local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress
local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount
local ItemSize = ItemRecordSize
local dupCount = 3
local MAX_SERIAL = 65535  -- 0xFFFF is used as empty marker, so max is 65535

print(string.format("Container addr: %08X", containerBaseAddress))

-- Pre-read source item data once
local srcItemData = readBytes(itemBaseAddr, ItemSize, true)
local srcQuality = readSmallInteger(itemBaseAddr + 0x04)

-- **First pass: Find maximum serial number across ALL items**
local maxSerialNumber = 0
local currentAddr = containerBaseAddress
for i = 1, MaxCount do
  local serialNum = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)
  if serialNum ~= 0xFFFF and serialNum &gt; maxSerialNumber then
    maxSerialNumber = serialNum
  end
  currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
end

print(string.format("Max serial number found: %d", maxSerialNumber))

-- **Second pass: Find empty slot**
currentAddr = containerBaseAddress
local emptySlotAddr = nil
local emptySlotIndex = 0

for i = 1, MaxCount - dupCount do  -- Ensure enough space for all duplicates
  local currentID = readSmallInteger(currentAddr)
  if currentID == 0xFFFF then
    emptySlotAddr = currentAddr
    emptySlotIndex = i
    print(string.format("Found empty slot #%d at %08X, src quality: %d", i, currentAddr, srcQuality))
    break
  end
  currentAddr = currentAddr + ItemSize
end

if not emptySlotAddr then
  print("No empty slots found")
  return
end

-- **Duplicate items with proper serial numbers (with wrap-around)**
local qualityAdjust = srcQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount) and 1 or -1

for i = 0, dupCount - 1 do
  local destAddr = emptySlotAddr + (i * ItemSize)

  -- Calculate new serial number with wrap-around
  local newSerialNumber = maxSerialNumber + i + 1
  if newSerialNumber &gt; MAX_SERIAL then
    newSerialNumber = newSerialNumber - MAX_SERIAL - 1  -- Wrap to 0, 1, 2...
  end

  -- Write entire item data at once
  writeBytes(destAddr, srcItemData)

  -- Adjust unique fields
  writeSmallInteger(destAddr, newSerialNumber)  -- Use proper serial number
  writeSmallInteger(destAddr + 0x04, srcQuality + (i * qualityAdjust))  -- Quality

  print(string.format("#%d, addr: %08X, Serial: %d, Quality: %d",
    i + 1, destAddr, newSerialNumber, srcQuality + (i * qualityAdjust)))
end

print("Done - Duplicated " .. dupCount .. " items")
closeLuaEngine()
{$asm}

  cmp dword ptr [hp_damage_type], 0 // off
  je code

  je one_damage
  cmp dword ptr [hp_damage_type], 2 // No damage
  je zero_damage

  //cmp eax, 1 // damage is already 1
  //je code

  cmp dword ptr [hp_damage_type], 3
  jne code

  // 3:by multiplier
  vmovss xmm14, [hp_fdamage_multi]
  vcvtsi2ss xmm15, xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15

  mov eax, 1
  jmp code

zero_damage:
  xor eax, eax
  jmp code

  vmovss xmm14, [enemy_damage_multi]
  vcvtsi2ss xmm15, xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15

  sub [rbx+00000114],eax
  jmp return
align 10 cc
  hp_damage_type: // 0:off, 1:1pt, 2:No dmg, 3:by multiplier
  dd 3
  align 10 0

  dd (float)0.75
  enemy_damage_multi:
  dd (float)1
  dd 0 0

  dd (float)1

  dd 1

  nop

              end

              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x4, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 5) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
  closeLuaEngine()
end

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end
end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {290, 9999999,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence

function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("%s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

```ps1
# ID is relative offset from first item ID (curr_ID - first_ID) in 4-digit hexadecimal format
[CmdletBinding()]
Param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$InputFile,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$OutputFile
)

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $InputFile -PathType Leaf)) {
    Throw "輸入檔案不存在！"
}

if (Test-Path -Path $OutputFile -PathType Leaf) {
    Throw "輸出檔案已存在！"
}

if (-not (Test-Path -Path (Split-Path -Path $OutputFile) -PathType Container)) {
    Throw "輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"
}

# 讀取 XML 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$xml = [xml](Get-Content -Path $InputFile -Encoding UTF8)

# 初始化結果陣列
$results = @()

# 取得第一筆資料的 String_No 作為基準值
$firstItem = $xml.Root.str | Select-Object -First 1
if ($null -eq $firstItem) {
    Throw "XML 檔案中沒有資料！"
}

# 從 String_No 中提取數字部分作為基準
$baseId = [int]($firstItem.String_No -replace '\D')

# 提取每一筆資料
foreach ($item in $xml.Root.str) {
    # 從 String_No 中提取數字部分
    $currentId = [int]($item.String_No -replace '\D')
    
    # 計算相對於第一筆的偏移量
    $offset = $currentId - $baseId
    
    # 取得 Text 的內容
    $text = $item.Text
    
    # 將偏移量轉換為 4 位 16 進位格式（大寫）
    $hexOffset = "{0:X4}" -f $offset
    
    # 組合成 "XXXX:文字" 格式
    $line = "${hexOffset}:${text}"
    
    # 將結果加入結果陣列
    $results += $line
}

# 將結果陣列輸出成文字檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$results | Out-File -FilePath $OutputFile -Encoding UTF8
```

```CT
        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 4)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x4, theQuality)
                --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 5) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

else
  --Author : bbfox@ https://opencheattables.com/
  --local containerBaseAddress = getAddressSafe("Atelier_Ryza.exe")+0x?????
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local isFound = false
  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destionation, quality should not the same if not in 999
  local dupCount = 3

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  --set Quality address
  currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 4)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x4, theQuality)
                --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 5) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

newmem:
  cmp r8d, #1    //skip count 1 to avoid bug
  je short endp
  cmp r8d, #2
  jne next1
  mov r8d, #10   // if count = 2 then set count to 10
  jmp short endp
next1:
  cmp r8d, #11
  jne short next2
  mov r8d, #15   // if count = 11 then set count to 15

next2:

  je its_enemy
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 0 // off
  je orig_code
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 1 // 1pt
  je one_damage
  cmp [hp_damage_type], 2 // No damage
  je zero_damage

  // Half
  cmp eax, 1
  je orig_code

  cmp [hp_damage_type], 3
  jne orig_code
  //3:by multiplier
  vmovss xmm14, [hp_fdamage_multi]
  cvtsi2ss xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15

  jmp orig_code

one_damage:
  mov eax, 1
  jmp orig_code
zero_damage:
  mov eax, 0
  jmp orig_code

its_enemy:
  vmovss xmm15, [vf_1]
  vmovss xmm14, [enemy_damage_multi]
  vcomiss xmm14, xmm15
  je orig_code

  cvtsi2ss xmm15, eax
  vmulss xmm15, xmm15, xmm14
  vcvtss2si eax, xmm15


orig_code:
code:

  jmp return

  hp_damage_type: // 0:off, 1:1pt, 2:No dmg, 3:by multiplier
  dd 3
  hp_fdamage_multi:
  dd (float)0.75
  enemy_damage_multi:
  dd (float)1
  vf_1:
  dd (float)1

INJECT_BATTLE_HP:
  jmp newmem
  nop

  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local TargetQuality = readSmallInteger('new_item_quality')
  print('new quality: '..TargetQuality)


  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
  local i
  local i1 = 0

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount, 1
    do
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)
        if (currentID0 ~= 65535 and i &gt;= 1)
        then
          currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
          if (currentQlty &lt; TargetQuality) then
            i1 = i1 + 1
            writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04, TargetQuality)
            --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x08, TargetQuality)
          end
        else
          print((i-1) .. " item(s) processed, " .. (i1) .. " item(s) changed.")
          break
        end
        prevID0 = currentID0
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  local i
  local i1 = 0

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount, 1
    do
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)
        if (currentID0 ~= 65535 and i &gt;= 1)
        then
          currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
          if (currentQlty &lt; TargetQuality) then
            i1 = i1 + 1
            writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04, TargetQuality)
            --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x08, TargetQuality)
          end
        else
          print((i-1) .. " item(s) processed, " .. (i1) .. " item(s) changed.")
          break
        end
        prevID0 = currentID0
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
    end

  end

  print("Done")
end

{$lua}
--NO_ACTIVATE
if syntaxcheck then return end

print("Start")

itemBaseAddr=readPointer("i_synh_container_base_addr") --higlighted item base addr
print("Source item addr: " .. string.format("%08X", itemBaseAddr))
if (itemBaseAddr == 0) then
  print("Please select item first")
  return
end

srcQualityAddress = itemBaseAddr

--getLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Atelier_Ryza.exe?")
else
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local isFound = false
  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destionation, quality should not the same if not in 999
  local dupCount = 3

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  --set Quality address
  currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 4)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x4, theQuality)
                --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 5) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

  local IsBypass = false

  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0

  local dupCount = 3

  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 4)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x4, theQuality)
                --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 5) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

if (getAddressSafe('Atelier_Ryza.exe') == nil)
then
  print("Atelier_Ryza.exe?")
else
  local containerBaseAddress = g_containerBaseAddress

  print("Container addr: " .. string.format("%08X", containerBaseAddress))

  local isFound = false
  local IsBypass = false
  local prevID0 = 1
  local currentID0 = 0
  local currentQlty = 0
  local theQuality = 0 -- for duplicate destionation, quality should not the same if not in 999
  local dupCount = 3

  local currentQualityAddress = containerBaseAddress --base item address
  local MaxCount = MaxContainerCount

  local prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress

  --set Quality address
  currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)

  if (IsBypass == false)
  then
    for i = 1, MaxCount-5, 1
    do
      if (isFound == false)
      then
        currentID0 = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress)

        if (currentID0 == 65535 and i &gt; 1)
        then
          print("Found empty slot in position #", i, ", address: #", string.format("%X", prevQualityAddress) .. ", src quality: " ..  currentQlty)
          isFound = true
          for i1 = 1, dupCount, 1
          do
            print("#", i1, ", addr: ", string.format("%X", currentQualityAddress), ", New ID: ", prevID0 + 1)
            for i2 = 0, ItemRecordSize-1, 1
            do
              if (i2 == 0)
              then
                -- 0~1: item id
                prevID0 = prevID0 + 1
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress, prevID0)
              end
              if ((i2 &gt; 1) and (i2 &lt; 4)) -- bypass offset 1 because already written; bytes before quality
              then
                --theByte = barray[i2]
                --print(string.format("%02X", theByte))
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end

              if (i2 == 4) -- Quality part; read once and write twice; bypass 7,8,9 offset
              then --Quality different than source to avoid game bug.
                theQuality = currentQlty

                if (theQuality &lt; (999 - dupCount)) then
                  theQuality = theQuality + i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                else
                  theQuality = theQuality - i1
                  print("new quality ".. theQuality)
                end
                writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x4, theQuality)
                --writeSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x6, theQuality)
              end


              if (i2 &gt; 5) -- rest part
              then
                thebyte = readBytes(srcQualityAddress + i2, 1, false)
                writeBytes(currentQualityAddress + i2, thebyte)
              end
            end
            prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
            currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
            currentID0 = prevID0
          end
        end

        prevID0 = currentID0
        currentQlty = readSmallInteger(currentQualityAddress + 0x04)
        prevQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress
        currentQualityAddress = currentQualityAddress + ItemRecordSize
      else
        break
      end
    end
  end

  print("Done")
end

--lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment
function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded )
    if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
        memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
    end
end

--memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {41, 158, 208,
       }

--determine event trigger sequence

function contains(table, val)
   local i = 0
   for i=1, #table do
      if table[i] == val then
         return true
      end
   end
   return false
end


function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
    if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
	    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
		    return false
	    end
    end
end

function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
    local baseAddr = nil
    local maxAddr = 0
    local modList = enumModules()

    for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
        if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
            baseAddr = mod.Address
            maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
            break
        end
    end

    if not baseAddr then
        print("❌ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!")
        return nil
    end

    -- Debug:
    --print(string.format("✅ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
    --print(string.format("📏 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))

    local ms = createMemScan()
    ms.firstScan(
        soExactValue,   -- exact scan
        vtByteArray,    -- AOB scan: Byte Array
        nil,            -- RoundingType (no used)
        signature,      -- AOB String
        nil,            -- no need by this scanoption
        baseAddr,       -- start addr
        maxAddr,        -- stop addr
        scanOptions or "+X+R", -- memory protectionflags
        fsmNotAligned,  -- no alignment
        "1",            -- alignment
        true,           -- using Hexadecimal
        true,           -- isNotABinaryString
        false,          -- isUnicode
        false           -- isCaseSensitive
    )

    ms.waitTillDone()

    local results = createFoundList(ms)
    results.initialize()

    if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
        local addr = results[0]
        --print("🎯 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    else
        --print("❌ AOB not found in " .. moduleName)
        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return nil
    end
end
```

`Atelier Ryza/Extract_ID.ps1`:

```ps1
# Set PS policy:
# Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
#
# https://github.com/bbfox0703/Mydev-Cheat-Engine-Tables
#
# .\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza\Data\saves\text_tc\str_monster_name.xml
# .\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza\Data\saves\text_tc\str_item_name.xml
# .\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza\Data\saves\text_tc\str_item_potential.xml
# .\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza\Data\saves\text_tc\str_item_effect.xml
# Ex:
# .\Extract_ID 'G:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Atelier Ryza\saves\text_jp\str_item_effect.xml' 'G:\Github\Mydev-Cheat-Engine-Tables\Atelier Ryza\jp_str_item_effect.csv'
#
# ID is absoulate number related to 1st item ID (curr_ID - 1st_ID)

[CmdletBinding()]
Param (
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$InputFile,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
    [string]$OutputFile
)

if (-not (Test-Path -Path $InputFile -PathType Leaf)) {
	# Throw "Input file not exist!"
    Throw "輸入檔案不存在！"
	# throw [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("輸入檔案不存在！"))
}

if (Test-Path -Path $OutputFile -PathType Leaf) {
	# Throw "Output file exist!"
    Throw "輸出檔案已存在！"
	# throw [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("輸出檔案已存在！"))
}

if (-not (Test-Path -Path (Split-Path -Path $OutputFile) -PathType Container)) {
	# Throw "Output directory not exist!"
    Throw "輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"
	# throw [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes("輸出的目錄不存在、或者不是目錄！"))
}

# 讀取 XML 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$xml = [xml](Get-Content -Path  $inputFile -Encoding UTF8)

# 初始化結果陣列
$results = @()

# 提取每一筆資料
foreach ($item in $xml.Root.str) {
    # 從 String_ID 中提取數字部分
    $idNumber = $item.String_No -replace '\D+(\d+)$', '$1'
    # 取得 Text 的內容
    $text = $item.Text

    # 組合成結果物件
    $result = New-Object PSObject -Property @{
        ID = $idNumber
        Text = $text
    }

    # 將結果物件加入結果陣列
    $results += $result
}

# 將結果陣列輸出成 CSV 檔案，並指定編碼為 UTF8
$results | Export-Csv -Path  $outputFile -Encoding UTF8 -NoTypeInformation
```

```CT
if not toggleCompactView then
    function toggleCompactView(sender, forceEnable)
        local isCompactMode = not (compactViewMenuItem.Caption == 'Compact View Mode')
        if forceEnable ~= nil then
            isCompactMode = not forceEnable
        end

        synchronize(function()
            compactViewMenuItem.Caption = isCompactMode and 'Compact View Mode' or 'Full View Mode'
            getMainForm().Splitter1.Visible = isCompactMode
            getMainForm().Panel4.Visible    = isCompactMode
            getMainForm().Panel5.Visible    = isCompactMode
        end)
    end
end

if not createCompactViewMenu then
    function createCompactViewMenu()
        if isCompactMenuCreated then return end

        synchronize(function()
            local mainMenu = getMainForm().Menu.Items
            compactViewMenuItem = createMenuItem(mainMenu)
            compactViewMenuItem.Caption = 'Compact View Mode'
            compactViewMenuItem.OnClick = toggleCompactView
            mainMenu.add(compactViewMenuItem)
        end)

        isCompactMenuCreated = true
    end
end

-- **デバッグモードの設定 (デフォルト: 無効)**
local debugMode = false

-- AOBScanModule関数
if not AOBScanModule then
    function AOBScanModule(moduleName, signature, scanOptions)
        local baseAddr = nil
        local maxAddr = 0
        local modList

        synchronize(function()
            modList = enumModules()
        end)

        for _, mod in ipairs(modList) do
            if string.lower(mod.Name) == string.lower(moduleName) then
                baseAddr = mod.Address
                maxAddr = baseAddr + mod.Size
                break
            end
        end

        if not baseAddr then
            if debugMode then print("❗ Error: Module " .. moduleName .. " not found!") end
            return nil
        end

        if debugMode then
            print(string.format("✔️ %s Base Address: 0x%X", moduleName, baseAddr))
            print(string.format("🔬 Scanning Range: 0x%X - 0x%X", baseAddr, maxAddr))
        end

        local ms = createMemScan()

        synchronize(function()
            ms.firstScan(
                soExactValue,
                vtByteArray,
                nil,
                signature,
                nil,
                baseAddr,
                maxAddr,
                scanOptions or "+X+R",
                fsmNotAligned,
                "1",
                true,
                true,
                false,
                false
            )
        end)

        ms.waitTillDone()

        local results = createFoundList(ms)
        results.initialize()

        local addr
        synchronize(function()
            if results.getCount() &gt; 0 then
                addr = results[0]
            end
        end)

        if addr then
            if debugMode then print("🔦 AOB found at: 0x" .. addr) end
        else
            if debugMode then print("💔 AOB not found in " .. moduleName) end
        end

        results.destroy()
        ms.destroy()
        return addr
    end
end

registerLuaFunctionHighlight('AOBScanModule')

-- Lua scripts that table checkbox will not be checked with "NO_ACTIVATE" in comment/script body
if not onMemRecPostExecute then
    function onMemRecPostExecute(memoryrecord, newState, succeeded)
        if memoryrecord.Type == vtAutoAssembler and memoryrecord.Script:find("NO_ACTIVATE") and newState and succeeded then
            synchronize(function()
                memoryrecord.disableWithoutExecute()
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- Memory record IDs now allowed to be 'locked'
IDs = {999999, 9999999}

-- Determine event trigger sequence
if not contains then
    function contains(table, val)
       for i = 1, #table do
          if table[i] == val then
             return true
          end
       end
       return false
    end
end

if not onMemRecPreExecute then
    function onMemRecPreExecute(memoryrecord, newstate)
        if contains(IDs, memoryrecord.ID) and newstate then
            synchronize(function()
                if not memoryrecord.OnActivate then
                    memoryrecord.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before, currentstate)
                        return false
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end
```
